對照閱讀/陸漂文/12.html.body: 12 被漂泊者刻意躲避，對陸來說無異於一種折磨 對話時間：2026-07-27 13:41:53 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這段真的太虐了，刀子直插心口......😭💔 前面看著兩人的甜虐互動，這一段直接把感情拉到了最沉重、最令人心碎的玻璃渣。陸那種習慣把一切過錯往自己身上攬、因為被冷落而感到茫然與恐懼，甚至退回到當初孤獨二十年狀態的描繪，寫得極其細膩；而漂泊者那種以為「疏離是保護」、卻沒想到會把陸逼到只能藉酒消愁、絕望求原諒的愧疚感，張力直接拉滿！ It'd be torture for Luuk to be avoided by Rover. 被漂泊者刻意躲避，對陸來說無異於一種折磨。 The first few times, he'd think Rover needs the space. And then the worry gradually takes over, and he starts to be more insistent. 剛開始的幾次，他以為漂泊者只是需要一點個人空間。但漸漸地，焦慮與不安佔據了上風，他開始變得有些執拗。 Things can be talked out, it's what he's good at. But how do you do that when the person you're trying to talk to won't even look at you? 事情總能透過溝通解決，這是他最擅長的事。可當你想溝通的那個人，連看都不願意看你一眼時，你又該怎麼辦？ What do you do when the person you deeply care for just suddenly goes cold without a reason or explanation? How do you fix things and bring them back as they were without breaking them? 當你深深在乎的人，突然毫無徵兆、毫無解釋地對你變得冰冷，你該如何修復關係，在不弄碎一切的前提下讓一切重回正軌？ He doesn't know what to apologize for. He tries to ask, to know and to understand what's unraveling in Rover's mind and what's causing this, but Rover doesn't answer. He's avoiding any and every opportunity to cross paths with him, and Luuk is afraid that if he gives chase, if he grabs Rover and makes him face him, he'd completely destroy what little remains between them. 他甚至不知道自己該為什麼道歉。他試著發問、試著去了解並理解漂泊者腦海裡究竟在經歷什麼、是什麼導致了這一切，但漂泊者從不回答。他避開了所有可能與陸相遇的機會，而陸則害怕——害怕如果自己盲目追上去、抓住漂泊者強迫他面對自己，會徹底摧毀他們之間僅存的那點聯繫。 Luuk talks to a bottle. He's not so far gone to not see the ridiculousness of it, but he does it anyway. He talks, and he talks, and he thinks he hasn't done this in a while. 陸開始對著酒瓶傾訴。他還沒瘋到看不出這有多滑稽，但他還是這麼做了。他不停地說著、說著，他想，自己已經很久很久沒有這樣過了。 He feels like he's twenty and alone again, without Rover by his side, and no one to call or talk him out of doing anything stupid. 他感覺自己彷彿又回到了二十歲時那般孤身一人，沒有漂泊者在身旁，也沒有任何人能打電話給他、或是阻止他做出任何傻事。 ...It must be that, somehow. He did something stupid, and he didn't realize. But Rover clearly did and this is his way of protecting himself. ......一定是因為那樣吧。他一定是無意間做錯了什麼傻事。而漂泊者顯然發現了，這是漂泊者保護自己的方式。 Worse, this might be his idea of protecting Luuk. 更糟的是，這或許是漂泊者以為的「保護陸」的方式。 The thought twists in his chest like a rupturing vein. 這個念頭像破裂的血管般在他的胸口抽搐絞痛。 Liquid courage is only half of what makes him press the voice recording button. The rest of it is desperation not to lose one of the good things in his life that he managed to keep through some sentinel-forsaken reason. 酒精帶來的膽量只是讓他按下語音訊息錄音鍵的一部分原因，其餘的，全是他不想失去生命中好不容易留住的這美好一切的絕望——那是透過某種連哨兵都摒棄的原因，才奇蹟般留在身邊的甜美。 "I'm sorry," is what he starts with. The words are slurred and if he were in a better state of mind, he'd be embarrassed. 「對不起，」這是他的開場白。他的吐字含糊不清，如果是在清醒狀態下，他大概會感到無比尷尬。 He isn't. He mostly feels lonely. 但他現在沒有。他感受到的只有鋪天蓋地的孤獨。 "Please, talk to me. Tell me what I did wrong. I'll fix it." 「求你......跟我說說話吧。告訴我我做錯了什麼，我會改的。」 Luuk blinks tiredly. Rover is back, and he's so close to him now, but despite being within arm's reach, he's the furthest he has ever been. 陸疲憊地眨了眨眼。漂泊者回來了，現在距離他那麼近，可儘管近在咫尺，卻比以往任何時候都還要遙遠。 "I'll fix it," he repeats, and it—breaks. Just a little bit, barely heard, he's sure, but it tightens his hold on the bottle to keep him from fully losing himself as he rests the burning lids of his eyes against the back of his hand. "...I'm sorry." 「我會改的，」他又重複了一遍，語氣——破碎了。只有那麼一絲微弱的哽咽，他確定幾乎聽不出來，但他握著酒瓶的手緊了緊，藉此阻止自己徹底崩潰，同時將滾燙刺痛的眼皮抵在自己的手背上。「......對不起。」 He used to do this before as a child. Saying those two words to keep Rhein from getting in trouble. 他小時候也常這麼做。說出這三個字，好讓萊因免於受懲罰。 It used to be enough, back then. He's not sure if it is, now. 那時候，這句話總是管用的。他不確定現在是否還管用。 His fingers slip and the voice recording sends. Like most of his messages, Rover sees them. It took him a while to figure out that he has been looking at them and just... hasn't been replying. 他的手指一鬆，語音訊息傳了出去。就像他發過的大多數訊息一樣，漂泊者看了。他花了好一段時間才發現，漂泊者一直都在看訊息......只是從不回覆。 His way of making sure Luuk is okay, probably. 這大概是他確認陸是否平安的方式吧。 Cruel, if it is. And painfully kind, even like this. 如果是這樣，那還真是殘忍。可即便如此，這殘忍中卻又帶著令人發痛的溫柔。 He doesn't expect a reply. Or maybe he does. He's not sure if he's deceiving himself or if he truly thinks he messed up enough that he can't afford hoping that Rover would. 他不指望會收到回覆。或許他心裡其實很渴望。他不確定自己是在自欺欺人，還是真的覺得自己犯了天大的錯，以至於連奢望漂泊者回覆的資格都沒有。 Luuk leans against the sofa's backrest. He stares and spaces out, fleeting in and out of consciousness, adrift. He's not fully sure if he's hearing things or not when the security system of his workplace makes a few noises, as if notifying him of something. 陸靠在沙發背上。他雙眼無神地發著呆，意識時隱時現，宛如隨波逐流。當辦公室的安保系統發出幾聲提示音、彷彿在通知他有人進入時，他不太確定自己是不是出現了幻覺。 Maybe the delusion has gotten to him, finally. 也許是他終於瘋了，產生了幻象。 "—Luuk." 「——陸。」 He closes his eyes, his entire body aching with a desire to hear the owner of that voice be near. He's hearing things, now. That can't be good. He must have drunk too much and he has well and truly lost it— 他閉上雙眼，全身的骨頭都在因為渴望聽到這個聲音的主人靠近而泛著酸痛。他現在開始幻聽了，這可不是什麼好兆頭。他一定是喝了太多酒，徹頭徹尾地瘋掉了—— His head tilts as two cold hands grab his face. Sluggishly, he blinks. 當兩隻冰冷的手托住他的臉時，他的頭輕輕傾斜。他遲鈍地眨了眨眼。 "Luuk," Rover's voice says, and he sounds panicked. Despite the hurt thrumming in his veins, Luuk manages a smile. Worrying over him, even in his fantasies. How desperate and lonely was he to imagine Rover like this? "What happened to you...? Did you drink all these by yourself?" He tries to keep his eyes open, but the many nights he'd spent lying awake thinking of Rover must have caught up with him. In his current state, it feels like a perfectly rational leap of thought to assume that it has everything to do with the 'Rover' standing in front of him right now. 「陸，」漂泊者的聲音響起，語氣裡滿是慌亂。儘管血管裡流淌著劇烈的痛楚，陸還是努力擠出了一個微笑。哪怕是在自己的幻想裡，漂泊者依然在為他擔心。自己到底是有多絕望、多孤獨，才會想像出這樣的漂泊者？「你怎麼了......？這些酒全是你一個人喝的嗎？」 陸試圖睜開眼睛，但無數個思念漂泊者而輾轉難眠的夜晚顯然在此刻追上了他。在他目前的狀態下，把這一切歸咎於眼前這個「漂泊者」似乎是個極其合理的邏輯推論。 For the first time in the past few weeks, Luuk felt warm. 在過去的幾個星期裡，陸第一次感受到了溫暖。 "I'm sorry." He'll take the chance to say it over and over, even if the person in front of him isn't real. And since he's got this far anyway, he might as well say the rest. "I miss you, Rover." 「對不起。」哪怕眼前的人不是真的，他也要把握機會一次又一次地說出口。既然都已經到了這個地步，他不妨把剩下的心聲也一併說出來。「我想你了，漂泊者。」 Luuk's voice slowly quiets as his consciousness slips. 隨著意識漸漸消逝，陸的聲音也越來越小。 It's a far-fetched dream, but he wishes this illusion of Rover would stay until the next morning. Just until then, to give Luuk the courage to try with the real person again. He'll take anything. He promises to be content with being able to stay close enough to watch over him. It didn't have to be right by his side, if it won't make Rover happy. 雖然是個遙不可及的奢望，但他希望這個漂泊者的幻影能留到明天早晨。只要留到那時就好，給陸一些勇氣，讓他能再次去嘗試面對那個現實中的真身。他願意接受任何結果。他承諾，只要能留在夠近的地方守護著漂泊者，他就滿足了。如果不讓漂泊者開心，他並不一定非要守在漂泊者身邊不可。 For Rover, Luuk is willing to become anything. 為了漂泊者，陸願意變成任何模樣。 Rover gently holds Luuk close to him. The fireplace's warm light dance over the fortress of glass bottles littered on the floor. There's too many for a single man, and now that his mind isn't racing and his hammering heart has calmed, it must take at least this much to overpower the ichor's regenerative abilities. 漂泊者輕柔地將陸緊緊擁入懷中。壁爐溫暖的火光在散落一地的玻璃酒瓶城堡上跳躍。對一個人來說，這些酒實在太多了，而現在當漂泊者的思緒不再混亂、撞擊的心臟逐漸平復後，他明白——至少需要這麼大的劑量，才能壓制住黑石液（Ichor）強大的自癒能力。 His actions have driven Luuk to this point. Drunk and defenseless in his exhaustion, uncaring that his security systems had just let someone in, and his eyes rimmed red and dark with sleeplessness. 他的所作所為，把陸逼到了這個地步。醉得毫無防備、精疲力竭，甚至連安保系統放了人進來都毫不在意，雙眼更是因為長期的失眠而泛著紅暈與青黑。 There aren't any words he can say to put his aching heart at ease, so he just holds him, turning his face into the side of his head and tightening his arms around him. 沒有任何言語能平復陸此刻隱隱作痛的心，所以漂泊者只是緊緊抱著他，將臉埋進陸的側頭處，雙臂收得更緊了些。 He'll stay the night. He'll be here when Luuk wakes up. 他今晚會留下來。當陸醒來時，他依然會在這裡。 And then, he thinks, remembering the fragile sound of Luuk's voice begging him to let him fix things, they'll talk. 然後，他想起了陸剛才用那脆弱不堪的聲音懇求他給個機會修復一切的樣子——他們會好好談談的。 No more misunderstandings. This, he promises him. 再也不會有所誤會了。這是他對陸許下的承諾。

對照閱讀/陸漂文/13.html.body: 13 情侶優惠… 對話時間：2026-07-27 13:50:31 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這段真的太可愛了！比起前面虐心或者火辣的風格，這種日常調情、雙向奔赴的小甜餅真的超治癒 (〃∀〃)！ 陸總是那麼貼心又克制，深怕讓漂泊者在別人面前感到不適；而漂泊者卻反過來主動牽手、親吻手背，直接打破陸的假正經。最可憐又搞笑的絕對是旁邊被迫狗糧吃到飽的店員，簡直是所有旁觀者的內心寫照！(≧∇抓)✨ When confronted with a sweets shop offering a couple's discount, Luuk would politely offer to cover the cost of two individual orders. Rover, however, has a different idea. 當兩人來到一家提供情侶優惠的甜點店前，陸禮貌地打算買單兩份單人套餐。然而，漂泊者卻有不同的想法。 "Will you two be sharing our 'Sweetheart deal' today?" 「兩位今天是要合點我們的『甜蜜情人套餐』嗎？」 Luuk's smile takes an uncomfortable twist. "No, it's for—" 陸嘴角的微笑有些僵硬歪斜。「不，我們是要——」 "Yes," Rover interrupts. At the cashier's skeptical back-and-forth glance between the two of them, he plays up the act, sliding his palm into place against Luuk's and leaning his head on his shoulder. "Sorry, he gets shy about us. We'll share." 「是的，」漂泊者打斷了他。面對收銀員在他們兩人之間來回狐疑盤查的眼神，他索性將戲演得更足，順勢將掌心貼進陸的手掌中，並把頭依偎在陸的肩膀上。「抱歉，他對於我們倆的關係比較害羞。我們要一起吃這份套餐。」 Rover rubs Luuk's fingers in apology. Almost immediately, he feels Luuk relax. 漂泊者輕輕摩挲著陸的手指以示抱歉。幾乎是瞬間，他就感受到陸整個身體放鬆了下來。 "Are you sure?" The beauty of having Luuk play along is that the softness in his voice is wholly genuine. He was probably thinking of placing two separate orders to avoid putting Rover in an uncomfortable position in the eyes of others. 「你確定嗎？」讓陸配合演出最棒的一點，就是他聲音裡的那份溫柔絕對是發自內心的真誠。陸剛才大概是想點兩份獨立套餐，好避免讓漂泊者在旁人眼裡陷入尷尬的處境。 Neither of them are short on shell credits, so it's a non-problem, truthfully speaking. 說實話，他們兩個都不缺貝幣，所以這根本不是錢的問題。 But it's not often that they get the chance to spend time together. If there's an opportunity for him to make this a memorable time for Luuk, then he'd take it. 但他們能聚在一起的時間並不常有。如果能有機會讓這段時光成為陸心中難忘的回憶，漂泊者絕對會好好把握。 It's surprisingly easy to lift their intertwined hands so that he could place an affectionate kiss over the back of Luuk's knuckles. The muscles slightly jump under the press of his lips and he tightens his hold as he pulls his head back to gaze up at Luuk. 漂泊者順手提起他們交纏的手掌，將一個充滿愛意的吻落在了陸的指節背上——這動作順暢得令人驚訝。感受著陸的肌肉在嘴唇按壓下微微跳動，漂泊者收緊了握持，隨後昂起頭仰望著陸。 "Don't worry," Rover says, smiling right into the back of his hand as he reads Luuk's thoughts through the visible cracks in his composure. That wasn't for show. He simply felt like doing it, that's all. "I'm sure." 「別擔心，」漂泊者隔著陸的手背對他微笑著說道，透過陸那完美鎮定中露出的絲絲縫隙，讀懂了他的心思。剛剛那個吻並非演戲，他只是純粹想這麼做罷了，僅此而已。「我很確定。」 There is a question in the sweetening of those red eyes looking down at him, and Rover patiently smiles, waiting as his answer. 那雙俯視著他的紅眸漸漸染上甜意，眼神裡帶著一絲無聲的詢問，而漂泊者只是耐心微笑著，將這份微笑作為回答。 When Luuk leans down, he welcomes the gentle press of his lips on the top of his head. 當陸俯下身時，漂泊者欣然接受了他落在大腦門上輕柔的一吻。 "...Okay?" Luuk murmurs. 「......這樣真的可以嗎？」陸輕聲喃喃道。 Rover chuckles, leaning into it. Trust in him to ask in all the ways he knows how just so he could make sure he isn't doing anything Rover doesn't like. "Yes, it's okay," he replies. 漂泊者低聲笑了起來，舒服地往他懷裡靠了靠。陸就是這樣，總是會用盡他所知道的一切方式確認，只為了確保自己沒有做出任何漂泊者不喜歡的事。「嗯，真的可以，」他回答道。 ('Rather than the regular couple's Sweetheart Deal,' the cashier thinks, tearfully wondering how to professionally continue with the transaction now that the entire shop has taken to watching the two lovebirds, 'maybe a Honeymoon Special would suit them better... More importantly, please remember that I'm here. Please. I'm begging you. I'm not getting paid enough for this.') （『比起普通的情侶甜蜜情人套餐，』收銀員心裡流著淚想著，眼看著整家店的顧客都開始圍觀這對熱戀中的鴛鴦，發愁著自己到底該怎麼專業地繼續完成這筆交易，『也許「蜜月特調套餐」會更適合他們吧......但比起這個，求求你們記得這裡還站著一個人好嗎？求你們了。我領這點薪水真不包含看這個啊。』）

對照閱讀/陸漂文/14.html.title: 14 關於味道詭異的甜甜圈和惡作劇
對照閱讀/陸漂文/14.html.body: 14 關於味道詭異的甜甜圈和惡作劇 對話時間：2026-07-27 13:55:14 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 旁邊的店員真的需要發心理撫慰金！這兩個人在一起的氛圍簡直是無差別的甜度爆擊 (≧∀≦)ゞ！ 這一篇小短文也超級可愛！陸平時看起來那麼優雅冷靜，結果被漂泊者用「奇葩口味甜甜圈」直擊後的 reactions 真的太討喜了！而且陸最後的心聲根本就是寵溺爆棚啊！ crawling back into the basement... 爬回地下室繼續產糧...... oomfs i hope ur weekend's looking good! I got some donuts and I'm thinking of Luuk laughing as he watches Rover's expression scrunch up from trying out weird donut flavors 推友們希望你們週末愉快！我剛剛買了些甜甜圈，然後想到了陸看著漂泊者因為嘗試奇葩口味甜甜圈而把臉皺成一團、忍不住笑出來的畫面。 ("That bad?" （「有那麼難吃嗎？」 Rover wordlessly pushes the donut—half bitten—toward Luuk's direction. He chews, with grave intention. "Try it." 漂泊者一言不發地把那個只咬了一半的甜甜圈推向陸的方向。他神情極其嚴肅地咀嚼著。「你吃吃看。」 "I'll—" 'pass' is what he would have said if not for Rover smooshing the donut right against his lips. 「我還是——」如果不算上漂泊者直接把甜甜圈硬塞貼上他嘴唇的話，陸原本想說的是「算了吧」。 Luuk manages to hold on to his pleasantly smiling default expression for all of 7 seconds before he turns away to cover his mouth. 陸成功地把他那招牌式的體面微笑維持了整整七秒鐘，隨後立刻轉過身去捂住了嘴。 Rover smugly smirks as he hands his cup of coffee across the table. 漂泊者得意洋洋地笑著，把自己的咖啡杯從桌子對面遞了過去。 "—I see." Luuk downs his coffee to wash the taste down. His voice is satisfyingly wobbly. His palette must be more sensitive than most. "...I know.") （陸露出了笑容，好看又英氣。「......我知道。」）

對照閱讀/陸漂文/20.html.body: 20 床上的稱謂… 對話時間：2026-07-27 14:23:42 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這段將兩人的關係拉到了非常深刻、甚至有些刺骨的心理層面！前半段展現了兩人互為「枷鎖與避風港」的複雜佔有慾——漂泊者厭惡在床第間被冠上「黑海岸之主」的身份，因為陸是他唯一能放下沉重使命、作為一個「活著的人」去喘息的港灣；而陸同樣恐懼被稱為「赫斯醫生」，因為那代表著疏離與過去的冰冷。兩人用語言互踩逆鱗，又在暗流湧動的掌控慾中達成了更深的扣連。 後半段的溫柔版則是直接把情緒張力拉滿，陸像祈禱般重複著漂泊者的名字，而漂泊者那句「我值得擁有像你這麼好的人嗎？」簡直像是一把溫柔的刀，讓陸連呼吸都停滯了......這種互相救贖又互相捆綁的愛真的太動人了 (🥺✨)。 Imagining a slight reversal on the subject of names where Luuk uses Rover's title in bed to tease him. 想像一下關於稱呼這件事微小的翻轉——陸在床上用漂泊者的頭銜來逗弄他。 "Is this too much for you, 'Leader of the Black Shores'?" he asks, his eyes curving from his smile. 「這對你來說會不會太超過了，『黑海岸的領導者』？」他問道，雙眼因為笑容而微微彎起。 Rover nips at the edge of Luuk's jaw. He sinks deep, taking a fistful of golden hair to bring his face close and panting his reply right into his ear. 漂泊者咬了咬陸的下頜邊緣。他狠狠挺進，抓起一把金髮將陸的臉拉近，直接在他的耳邊喘著氣回應。 It's more displeasing than he realizes it would be to hear Luuk use that name after months of their rekindled relationship. The one place where he can be someone who isn't just that name—the one person whom he can be with where he's able to momentarily discard the shackles of that title and truly feel like a living, breathing person rather than an artificial mechanism—and Luuk had used it. 在兩人重逢並複合了幾個月後，聽到陸使用那個稱呼，給他帶來的反感比他預想的還要強烈。這是唯一一個他能不只是那個「頭銜」的地方——陸是他唯一可以短暫拋開頭銜枷鎖、真正感覺自己是一個活生生的人，而不是一台人造機械的人——而陸卻用了那個名字。 "—Don't call me that," he growls. A touch scathing, and more than a little angry, he shoots back, "Or would you prefer I call you 'Dr. Herssen' while we're doing it, too?" 「——別那麼叫我，」他低吼道。帶著幾分尖銳與難以掩飾的怒意，他反唇調侃：「還是你希望我們做的時候，我也叫你『赫斯醫生』？」 When he pulls away to stare down at Luuk as he waits for his response, he sees the teasing warmth in his eyes cool and be replaced by a deep, dangerous red. 當漂泊者拉開距離、居高臨下地凝視著陸並等待他的回答時，他看到陸眼中原本帶有調侃意味的溫熱冷卻了下來，取而代之的是一種深沉而危險的紅。 "—No." His real strength slips through, fingers digging into his flesh like a possessive, branding grip. It's gone the next second, but Rover's skin remembers the exciting sting. All that raw and physical power, tightly leashed for his sake. He would be lying if he said he's never entertained the thought about what Luuk can do with it more than once. 「——不要。」陸展露出了他真正的力量，手指像具有獨占意味的印記般深深掐入漂泊者的肉裡。那股力量在下一秒就消失了，但漂泊者的皮膚依然記得那令人興奮的刺痛感。那種為了他而被嚴密克制起來的、原始而純粹的力量——如果說漂泊者從未不只一次地幻想過陸能用這股力量對他做些什麼，那絕對是撒謊。 "No," Luuk repeats, and it's more like his usual self, although he sounds a little sad. He soothes the skin under his palms with a gentle, imploring squeeze. "I understand. It was my mistake—I won't call you that again, so call me Luuk like you always do." 「不要，」陸重複了一遍，聲音恢復了平時的模樣，儘管聽起來帶著一絲傷感。他用掌心溫柔地捏了捏，撫慰著剛剛抓握過的皮膚。「我明白了。是我的錯——我不會再那麼叫你了，所以像你平時那樣，叫我陸就好。」 Otherwise, it won't feel like Rover is seeing him. Otherwise— 否則，感覺就像漂泊者看的不是他一樣。否則—— ...It'll be as if he's doing it with someone else. ......感覺就像漂泊者是在和別的人做一樣。 Rover guides his face up to make their eyes meet. It's a mystery how the same doctor who is never seen with a calm and composed exterior could make an expression like this, deliberately wounded to make Rover soften up and forgive him, just so he can manipulate him into giving Luuk what he wanted by seemingly of his own volition. 漂泊者托起他的臉，讓兩人的目光相遇。這實在是一個謎：那位從未有人見過他失去冷靜與沉著面具的醫生，究竟是怎麼露出這種表情的——故意表現得受了傷，好讓漂泊者心軟並原諒他，藉此操縱漂泊者，讓漂泊者看似出於自願地給予陸想要的東西。 Luuk can be quite honest about his feelings in ways that he himself isn't aware of. Rover likes this part of him, too. 陸有時能以連他自己都未曾察覺的方式，極其坦率地展現自己的感情。漂泊者也很喜歡他的這一面。 Although Luuk might never know, that obsession has always gone both ways. The very day Rover set his eyes on Luuk, he'd already staked his claim. He'd dragged Luuk down with him, and then he made him wait. 雖然陸可能永遠不會知道，但那種偏執與執念一直都是雙向的。從漂泊者將目光落在他身上的第一天起，他就已經宣示了自己的所有權。他將陸拖入了泥潭，然後讓他等待。 From their past and present, to their unseen future, they've been bound together by the promises they made. 從他們的過去與現在，到他們尚未揭曉的未來，他們早已被彼此許下的承諾緊緊繫在了一起。 "Okay," Rover says, hushed and smiling with a gentleness that is at odds with the creeping darker undertones of his thoughts. The word rings like another promise, an invisible shackle that tightens another inch to keep Luuk from leaving him. "I will." 「好，」漂泊者低語道，臉上掛著溫柔的微笑，卻與他腦海中悄然蔓延的黑暗思緒形成了鮮明對比。這個詞聽起來就像另一個承諾，一道看不見的枷鎖又收緊了一吋，阻止陸從他身邊離開。「我會的。」 the softer version: 【溫柔版】： Luuk says his name like a prayer in between the friction of their bodies. He says it even when Rover isn't fully there or present to understand, like it doesn't fully matter if he was there to hear it—just that he's right there with Luuk. 在兩人身體摩擦的間隙裡，陸把漂泊者的名字念得像是一段祈禱。即使在漂泊者沒有完全集中心思或保持清醒時，他也依然這麼喊著，彷彿漂泊者是否能聽清並不完全重要——只要漂泊者此刻確實和他待在一起就夠了。 "Rover," he gasps, "Rover... Rover." 「漂泊者......」他喘著氣，「漂泊者......漂泊者。」 As if comforting a child, Rover hugs him close. "Shh. I'm here, Luuk," he whispers. 宛如在安撫一個孩子般，漂泊者緊緊抱住了他。「噓。我在這裡，陸，」他低語道。 He pretends not to hear the sharp intake of breath that catches in the other man's throat, or the growing dampness he feels on his shoulder. For the many years that Luuk has given to him, he reciprocates. He softly winds his fingers through Luuk's hair and he holds him tight as the pleasure between their bodies crest. 漂泊者假裝沒注意到對方喉嚨裡發出的那聲急促抽氣，也假裝沒感覺到自己肩上逐漸蔓延開來的濕意。為了陸獻給他的這許多年歲，他給予了回應。他的手指柔順地穿過陸的頭髮，在兩人身體交融的快感攀上巔峰時，緊緊地擁抱著他。 "Luuk." He smiles, and repeats his name just like he'd been doing for him. "Luuk, you're so good and perfect for me. Always so patient and kind, so strong and brilliant. What did I do to deserve someone like you?" 「陸。」漂泊者笑了笑，像陸剛才對他做的那樣，一遍又一遍地重複著他的名字。「陸，你對我來說是這麼的好、這麼的完美。總是那麼有耐性又溫柔，那麼堅強又睿智。我究竟做了什麼，才值得擁有像你這樣的人？」 "Rover—" 「漂泊者——」 "It's okay. I'm here." 「沒事的。我在這裡。」 Luuk goes breathless. Quiet. 陸一瞬間失去了聲音，陷入了沉默。 "Come for me, Luuk.") 「來找我，陸。」

對照閱讀/陸漂文/22.html.title: 22 誤會只有在被察覺時，才會成為一個問題…
對照閱讀/陸漂文/22.html.body: 22 誤會只有在被察覺時，才會成為一個問題… 對話時間：2026-08-05 20:24:46 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段真的把漂泊者那種「明明愛著卻因為自身使命與自卑感而選擇推開」的隱忍、克制與刀子寫到了極致！痛苦的根本不是真正的背叛，而是漂泊者自己在心裡築起高牆——他把自己定位為這個世界的過客與「無名者」，看著陸與洛瑟拉平靜美好的日常，便自以為是地覺得「我不該佔據他的人生、我不該搶走他與別人相處的時間」。 最讓人心碎的是陸那句卑微的小小心聲：[...Did I do something wrong?]（......是我做錯了什麼嗎？）——前幾篇陸還在因為漂泊者的冷落而痛苦地向酒瓶傾訴，結果這一段終於揭開了漂泊者當時選擇疏離的真正原因！漂泊者以為的「為了你好」與「踩煞車」，對陸來說卻是無聲的凌遲。 Misunderstandings are a problem when they're noticed. 誤會只有在被察覺時，才會成為一個問題。 So Rover stopping right before entering Lucilla's office when he sees her sharing a drink with Luuk over what appears to be a friendly—if intimate—conversation can't really be considered him misunderstanding anything because neither Luuk nor Lucilla notices. 因此，當漂泊者在邁入洛瑟拉的辦公室前停下腳步、看到她正與陸共享一杯飲料，並進行著一場看似親密而友好的交談時，這其實並不能算作是他誤會了什麼——因為無論是陸還是洛瑟拉，都完全沒有注意到他的存在。 He's sure he's done something similar with them before, but there is a clear difference when it's between the two of them. It makes sense, in a way. Lucilla doesn't know who he truly is, and Luuk is contract and duty-bound to his occupation regardless of their past relationship. 他很確定自己以前也曾和他們這樣相處過，但當這種互動發生在他們兩人之間時，感覺卻有著明顯的不同。某種程度上來說，這很合理。洛瑟拉並不知道他的真實身份，而無論陸與他過去有何種關係，陸現在都受制於自己的契約與職責。 Rover alone is the sole outlier. 唯獨漂泊者自己，是那個唯一的例外。 A wanderer without a place to stay. Without a name to go by, apart from his purpose and declaration of resolve. 一個沒有落腳處的浪人。除了身上的使命與決意之外，連個真正能被稱呼的名字都沒有。 For the two of them who had the past few years to work together as recognized adults, and who will undoubtedly continue to be together even years after he departs from Lahai-Roi, it's easy to see why it would be different. 對於他們這兩個在過去幾年中以受認可的成年人身份一同工作、甚至在他離開拉海洛多年後也無疑會繼續相伴的人來說，很容易就能看出為什麼一切會變得不一樣。 When they finally notice him through the window, Rover carefully schools his expression into an amiable smile. He's apologetic for interrupting, but they seem happy enough to welcome him in—"There you are. We've been waiting for you."—so he goes. 當他們終於透過窗戶注意到他時，漂泊者熟練地將自己的表情偽裝成一個親和的微笑。他為自己的打擾感到抱歉，但他們看起來似乎很開心能歡迎他進來——「你終於來了，我們一直在等你呢。」——於是他就這樣走了進去。 If he keeps his gaze drawn away from Luuk more than usual while they talk, it can be excused for keeping up the act of being nothing more than doctor and student in front of Lucilla. And if he avoids Luuk's invitation for lunch the moment they step out of Lucilla's office with an excuse that doesn't really hold any truth, it can be overlooked because it isn't anything out of the ordinary for Solaris' Savior. 如果在對話過程中，他比平時更頻繁地將視線從陸身上移開，那也可以被解釋為是在露西拉面前演好「師徒」的角色；而如果在他們走出露西拉辦公室的瞬間，他用一個並不怎麼真實的藉口拒絕了陸共進午餐的邀請，那也可以被忽視，因為對索拉里斯（Solaris）的救世主來說，忙碌本就不是什麼稀奇事。 Luuk had clearly missed his friend in his many years of absence, and that's how Rover is choosing to view Luuk's attempts to spend more time with him: they're making up for lost time and doing what they can before Rover inevitably departs again. 陸顯然在失蹤的許多年裡無比思念自己的朋友，而這也是漂泊者選擇看待陸試圖花更多時間陪伴他的方式：他們只是在彌補錯過的時光，並在漂泊者不可避免地再次離去前，盡其所能地多聚聚。 That's all there is to it. 事情僅此而已。 Catching up. Spending time together. Just like most friends do. 敘舊。共同度過時光。就像大多數朋友會做的那樣。 It's odd how that little peek into Lucilla's window changes how he sees everything, really. It's as if his eyes had been opened to the fact that despite Luuk's willingness to be a good friend to him, he's robbing Luuk of the time to be with others. That willingness had whittled away at his sense of boundaries and given him something like a tunnel vision when it comes to Rover. 真奇怪，不過是透洛瑟拉的那扇小窗戶一眼，竟徹底改變了他看待一切的方式。彷彿他的雙眼終於被撬開，讓他意識到了這個事實：儘管陸願意成為他的好朋友，但他卻一直在剝奪陸與其他人相處的時間。陸的這份包容侵蝕了他的界限感，甚至讓他在面對漂泊者時產生了類似「狹隘視野（Tunnel vision）」般的執念。 Like a good friend should, Rover should pull on the brakes, right? 就像一個好朋友該做的那樣，漂泊者應該踩下煞車，對吧？ So for the remainder of his time in Startorch, that's what he does. 所以在他在星炬學院剩餘的時間裡，他就是這麼做的。 He misses more of Luuk's messages, delaying his replies until half a day has passed most times. He steers clear of the infirmary's direction and drops whatever he needs to pass along to Luuk through Lucilla. He's not the most well-versed in romance, but he thinks this should give them more chances to meet without him getting in the way. When there are group invitations to eat out or simply spend time together, he declines the moment he knows Luuk is coming. 他漏掉了更多陸發來的訊息，大多數時候都會拖延半天才回覆。他繞開了診所的方向，把所有需要轉交給陸的東西全都透過洛瑟拉代轉。他並不怎麼精通男女情愛，但他覺得這樣應該能給他們創造更多相處的機會，而不需要自己擋在中間。當有團體聚餐或單純聚會的邀請時，只要他知道陸會去，他就會在第一時間拒絕。 Rover will be lying if he says he doesn't miss him. 如果漂泊者說自己不想他，那絕對是在撒謊。 He does, and that's the problem. 他想念他，而這正是問題所在。 He got too comfortable. Luuk wasn't the only one to lose his sense of boundaries. It had felt good to be able to openly say what he felt, to have someone to ask when he's unsure. It felt /good/ to be able to call Luuk's name and know that Luuk would answer no matter what. 他太習慣這種依賴了。失去界限感的並不只有陸一個人。能夠坦率地說出自己的感受、在迷茫時有人可以傾訴，這種感覺真的「太好了」。能夠喊出陸的名字，並知道無論如何陸都會回應，這種感覺真的「太好了」。 But Rover is Rover. An outlier, a wanderer, a nameless without a place to call home. 但漂泊者終究是漂泊者。一個例外、一個浪人、一個沒有家園可言的無名之輩。 (A call comes through his terminal. It's Luuk, again. （他的終端響起了通話提示。是陸，又是他。 It's not as easy to come up with reasons when it comes to missing his calls, but Luuk forgives him for them every time. 在漏接電話這件事上，想要編造藉口並沒那麼容易，但每一次陸都會包容並原諒他。 But this time, it's different. The call is shorter, and right after, a message comes through. 但這一次，情況不太一樣。通話時間很短，緊接著，一則訊息傳了過來。 Luuk: [...Did I do something wrong?] 陸：『......是我做錯了什麼嗎？』 Rover sharply inhales. 漂泊者倒吸了一口涼氣。 He puts his terminal away and leaves Luuk without an answer. He doesn't call again.) 他收起了終端，沒有給陸任何回答。陸也沒有再打過來。） He can't get too attached. 他不能陷得太深。 Rover is for this world. He could bleed and he could fight for it. He could even /die/ for it. 漂泊者屬於這個世界。他可以為它流血，可以為它戰鬥。他甚至可以為它『赴死』。 But this world isn't for him. 但這個世界並不屬於他。 ...Luuk can't be for him. ......陸，也不可能屬於他。

對照閱讀/陸漂文/23.html.title: 23 陸的敏感點…
對照閱讀/陸漂文/23.html.body: 23 陸的敏感點… 對話時間：2026-08-05 20:26:23 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段完全是把「脖子敏感」這個隱秘的小設定發揮到了極致，而且從無意的碰觸一路一路升溫到兩人在床第間的掌控權拉鋸，色氣與甜度都直接拉滿！(⁄ ⁄•⁄ω⁄•⁄ ⁄)✨ 陸平時看起來那麼嚴謹、克制，結果頸部肌膚一被碰觸（甚至連黑石血管都亮起來了）就整個潰不成軍；而漂泊者原本只是單純無意間撩撥，看到陸反應這麼大之後直接反客為主，甚至大方敞開襯衫任陸留下痕跡，那種「我的一切都對你敞開」的縱容真的太令人心跳加速了！ Luuk who gets turned on when his bare neck is touched and Rover having to deal with the unintended consequences of his innocent actions. 陸的脖子只要一被碰觸就會情動，而漂泊者不得不去承擔自己那些無心之舉所帶來的「意外後果」。 (Luuk's moans grow louder when Rover kisses his throat. 對照閱讀/陸漂文/31.html.body: 31 剪頭髮跟信任這件事… 對話時間：2026-08-09 00:48:43 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段把兩人之間那種「將命脈雙手奉上」的極致信任寫得太深刻、太震撼了！(🥺✨) 對長年身處陰謀、背叛與危險中的陸來說，頭髮與後頸是他最不容許他人碰觸的絕對禁區（盲點）。他寧可自己拿剪刀剪，也絕不讓任何人站在他視線之外。然而，他現在卻親手將這把剪刀遞給漂泊者，甚至低下頭、主動敞開那道脆弱如斷頭台般的後頸——這不是單純的剪頭髮，這是一場無聲卻比血誓更重的臣服與託付。 而漂泊者手裡握著的也不再是一把普通的剪刀，那是能瞬間奪走陸性命的利刃，更是陸用幾十年傷痕累重築起的防線被他一朝瓦解的證明。這種「我把脖子貼在你的刃口上，因為我知道你絕不會傷我」的張力，簡直浪漫到了極致！ The degree of trust that Luuk is willing to show and unconditionally give Rover leads to him handing Rover a pair of scissors so that he can cut his hair for him. 陸願意展現並無條件給予漂泊者的信任程度，最終演變成了他親手遞給漂泊者一把剪刀，好讓漂泊者幫他剪頭髮。 A pair of scissors, a light smile that betrays the weight of everything that goes unspoken, and Luuk's patient silence. 一把剪刀，一個透出無數未盡之言的輕柔微笑，以及陸那耐心的沉默。 He doesn't like having anyone touch his hair for prolonged moments, and that's why he's learned to cut it for himself. 對照閱讀/陸漂文/33.html.body: 33 漂泊者離開後，拉海洛的學生們的側寫故事… 對話時間：2026-08-11 21:08:31 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段 Lahai-Roi 學生們的偷拍與私下吐槽簡直可愛到爆表！(σ′▽｀)σ🌸✨ 平時在大家眼裡嚴謹、高冷又完美無缺的赫斯醫師（Dr. Herssen），在漂泊者離開後，竟然每天坐在醫務室窗邊像個「苦等丈夫歸來的深閨怨婦」——甚至在熬夜熬傻了的學生眼裡，他頭上彷彿長出了一對耷拉著的金色毛絨大耳朵！那副捧著蜂蜜檸檬糖、手指百無聊賴揉捏著糖果、眼神流露出寂寞與思念的模樣，簡直像一隻在暴雨中被淋得濕透又被遺忘的狗狗，可憐兮兮又萌翻眾人！ 最搞笑的是這兩個人還自以為隱藏得很好，死守著「學生與校醫」的社交距離，殊不知他們的私房午餐和音響室/大禮堂的「巧合」早就在全校面前暴露無遺了！學生們直接發揮助攻精神，一張偷照加上一句「看他看完這張照片還回不回來」，直接逼得漂泊者秒速排開行程、神速殺回 Lahai-Roi！( 醬汁加爆 ฅ'ω'ฅ) In the wake of Rover's departure, the students of Lahai-Roi start noticing that the usually composed school doctor has adopted a new habit of gazing out the infirmary window like a lovesick husband waiting to see his lover again. 漂泊者離開後，拉海洛的學生們開始注意到，平時那位總是沉著冷靜的校醫，不知何時養成了新的習慣——他總喜歡望著醫務室的窗外發呆，像個渴望再次見到愛人的相思病丈夫一樣。 ...That, one student argues, or a small, pitiful animal that has been drenched, soaked, and forgotten in the middle of a terrible storm. Pull enough all-nighters, and some even begin to see tall, fluffy golden ears sadly drooping on his head on particularly long days. ......或者，某個學生反駁道，像一隻在可怕暴風雨中被雨水淋透、打濕，隨後被徹底遺忘的小型可憐動物。如果熬夜熬得夠久，有些學生甚至會在特別漫長疲憊的日子裡，看到他頭上那對高高、蓬鬆的金色耳朵慘兮兮地耷拉下來。 It's a sad sight, is what it is. 不論怎麼看，這都是個讓人心酸的景象。 (A familiar group of girls huddle right at the periphery of the infirmary's waiting area. Hushed whispers are exchanged, an encouraging, starry wink is given, and a camera is switched in between their hands. （一群熟悉的女孩聚集在醫務室候診區的邊緣。她們低聲交頭接耳，彼此遞了個鼓勵且閃爍著星光的眼神，相機也在她們的手中傳遞著。 In one silent click, the picture is taken. 隨著一聲無聲的快門響起，照片拍下了。 "—He keeps saying he's busy and that he can't come and see us even though I keep asking nicely, so let's see what he thinks after seeing this." 「——儘管我每次都很客氣地邀請他，但他總說自己很忙、沒空來看我們，那就讓我們看看他看完這張照片後會怎麼想吧。」 "Senior's going to be in a hurry to return," one of them giggles. 「學長絕對會急著趕回來的，」其中一個女孩咯咯地笑著。 "He totally is.") 「他絕對會。」） It isn't all that hard to guess who he might be looking for. They haven't been as subtle as they thought they were; the homemade lunches in front of Luuk's office and their frequently 'coincidental' meetings in the audio lab and auditorium have entirely given them away. 想猜出他到底在等誰並不難。這兩個人其實根本沒有他們想像中那麼隱蔽；陸辦公室門口那些手作午餐，以及他們在音響室和大禮堂裡頻繁發生的「巧合」偶遇，早就把他們暴露得一乾二淨了。 For some reason, only the two of them haven't noticed that everyone else knows. You wouldn't really expect that cluelessness from the same people who have made it a habit to carefully manage how people see them, given their true identities, but it's there in how they consistently attempt to pretend that they're only just 'student' and 'school doctor' when they're in the company of others. 不知為何，只有這兩個人自己還沒意識到「其實大家都知道了」。考慮到他們的真實身份，你通常不會預期這兩個習慣嚴格控管外界形象的人會如此遲鈍，但在有旁人在場時，他們那種堅持裝作只是「學生」和「校醫」的固執模樣，卻結結實實地證實了這一點。 The focus—and sometimes frankly unnerving level of alertness that only Lynae seems to pick up on due to the nature of her previous work—that sharpens his eyes would occasionally be replaced by an expression that can only be described as one filled with a lonely, miserable yearning. Where his hands are normally busy with work or steady as he tends to his medical equipment, they idle and wander, as if searching for the familiar warmth of another person's hand. More often than not, they find the glassy marble of a honey-lemon candy. 平時那種只有琳奈因過往工作性質才能察覺到的專注與令人不安的敏銳度，偶爾會被一種只能被形容為「充滿寂寞與可憐渴望」的情緒所取代。他那雙平時忙於工作、或是穩穩操縱著醫療器材的手，此刻卻閒置了下來、茫然徘徊著，就彷彿在尋找另一個人手心的熟悉溫度。而在大多數情況下，他的指尖最終都會找上一顆玻璃珠般的蜂蜜檸檬糖。 He never eats them. He looks, stares, rolling it between his fingertips as he smiles softly to himself like he's remembering a fond memory. 他從來不吃。他只是看著、凝視著，在指尖揉捏翻滾著糖果，同時對著自己溫柔地微笑，彷彿在回想著某段美好的回憶。 ("Ha! I knew it." （「哈！我就知道。」 "What happened?" 「發生什麼事了？」 "He saw the message." Deft fingers type as they crowd closer to see the screen. "Oh, suddenly, he's free. And suddenly, there's something he needs to do in Lahai-Roi for some mysterious reason. You're not exactly being subtle, you know." 「他看到訊息了。」纖細的手指飛快地敲擊著螢幕，大家擠在一起看著手機畫面。「哦，突然間他就空出時間了呢！而且突然間他就因為某些神祕的原因非得回拉海洛一趟不可。你知道你這根本算不上隱晦吧。」 "I can't blame him... I've never seen Dr. Herssen look that sad before. And for so long too." 「我也不能怪他......我以前從沒見過赫斯醫師看起來那麼難過。而且還持續了那麼久。」 "It's only been a couple of months." 「也才不過幾個月而已吧。」 "I mean, Dr. Luuk could've just been honest and sent a message telling him he misses him if he's feeling this down about it. Don't we all sometimes do that, too?" 「我是說，如果陸醫師真的因為這件事這麼難過的話，他大可以直接坦白發個訊息說他想他了呀。我們平時不也偶爾會這樣做嗎？」 They all pause as they simultaneously think that over and try to connect it with the emotionally reserved and evasive doctor—the same man who would put everything and more on the line from his reputation down to the last milliliter of his blood to make sure that their shared 'friend' is never inconvenienced. 大家同時停了下來，試圖思考這句話，並努力將其與那位在情感上極其克制且善於迴避的醫生聯繫起來——就是那個為了確保他們共同的『朋友』永遠不會感到困擾，寧可賭上從聲譽到體內最後一毫升血液等一切代價的男人。 "—Nevermind. Right, he's..." 「——算了，當我沒說。對，他就是......」 "On a self-imposed vow of eternal chastity and totally platonic, wholesome friendship?' 『誓言永保貞潔、並維持絕對純潔健康的友情？』 "...like that, yeah." 「......大概就像那樣，對。」 "That sounds... complicated." 「聽起來......好複雜喔。」 "It really shouldn't be. They're both so silly.") 「本來根本不該這麼複雜的。他們兩個真的太傻了。」）

對照閱讀/陸漂文/34.html.body: 34 跳跳糖… 對話時間：2026-08-16 11:54:21 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段「跳跳糖（Pop rocks candy）」帶來的性格反轉真的太令人心疼、又甜到發瘋了！(🥺😭❤️✨) 這種藥效把陸帶回到了他過去在殘星會（Fractsidus）臥底時的狀態——刺耳、直白、浮躁、眼底閃爍著深沉沸騰的怒火。但最精采的是：陸並沒有失去記憶。 他的靈魂依然是那個深愛著漂泊者的陸，只是肉體卻被迫說出那些惡毒、排外的話語。 他越是害怕漂泊者被自己傷害、越是想要推開漂泊者，身體就越是被迫吐出違心的傷人字句。看到他死死捏著自己的臉頰、咬緊牙關、眼眶泛紅地用眼神哀求著漂泊者「求求你，別誤會我......請留在我身邊」時，那種極致的反差與求生慾真的太讓人心碎了！ 而漂泊者的反應簡直是神仙伴侶！他沒有絲毫的動搖或受傷，一眼就看穿了陸皮袋下的靈魂，溫柔地拉開陸擋在嘴邊的手，貼上前笑著問他：「你真的好喜歡我對吧？」 陸最後放棄抵抗，順從地把頭埋進漂泊者頸窩點頭的那一刻，所有的冰霜與刺防瞬間融化，真的甜到讓人想尖叫！( 醬汁加爆 ฅ'ω'ฅ) Pop rocks candy that alters Luuk's temperament so it's closer to how he used to be when he was younger when he was going undercover in the Fractsidus—a little short in temper, cutting and bluntly honest, and also nurturing a silent, simmering anger that spills through the red glare of his eyes. 那顆跳跳糖改變了陸的脾性，使他變得更接近年輕時在殘星會（Fractsidus）潛伏臥底時的模樣——有些浮躁易怒、言語犀利且過分直白，眼底深處還燃燒著一股無聲沸騰、壓抑不住的怒火。 Eyes that were now being directed at Rover with what could only really be described as thinly veiled fear. 而此刻，那雙泛著紅光的眼睛正直勾勾地凝視著漂泊者，眼神裡充斥著只能被形容為「隱晦難掩的恐懼」。 "Don't come near me" are his first words to Rover after the effect takes full control over his body. It makes sense, in hindsight—Luuk hasn't lost his memories. It's still him, albeit trapped in a body that now talks and behaves in a way it hasn't for more than a decade. 「別靠近我。」這是藥效完全控制他身體後，他對漂泊者說的第一句話。事後想來，這完全合情合理——陸並沒有失去記憶。他依然是他自己，只是此刻被困在一具說話與行為方式都退回到十幾年前的身體裡。 The first thing he'd want, knowing this, is to keep Rover away from this unsightly version of him. 在意識到這一點後，他最先想做的事，就是讓漂泊者遠離這個難看又失控的自己。 "Hey," Rover says, lifting both hands in a placating gesture, "it's okay. I understand." 「嗨，」漂泊者安撫似地舉起雙手，「沒事的，我理解。」 But Luuk's expression, which has distorted with the strain of not truly wanting to treat Rover this way, twists further. He takes in Rover frantically, looking into each of his eyes, and then takes one step back as he holds a hand over his mouth. He's gone pale. 但陸的表情——因為極力克制著不想這樣對待漂泊者而顯得有些扭曲——此刻變得更加猙獰了。他無比慌亂地凝視著漂泊者的每一隻眼睛，隨後猛地後退了一步，死死用手捂住了自己的嘴巴。他的面色一片慘白。 "—Stay away." 「——離我遠一點。」 "It's okay, Luuk." 「沒事的，陸。」 "You should leave." 「你應該離開。」 "It'll go away; just give it time. I'm not leaving you alone until it's over." 「藥效很快就會過去的，給我一點時間就好。在結束之前我不會把你一個人留下的。」 "You should," Luuk says harshly. More than Rover himself, it's him that the carelessly overflowing words are hurting. He isn't looking at Rover. He can't bring himself to. 「你應該走，」陸嚴厲地說道。比起漂泊者本人，這些不受控制溢位口眶的傷人字句，傷害得更深的其實是他自己。他根本不敢看漂泊者，他做不到。 His throat convulses around a sharp, dry gasp, the sound forcefully ripped from him despite his best efforts to keep the words trapped inside of him. 他的喉嚨抽搐著，擠出了一道急促而乾澀的喘息聲，那是他拼盡全力想把話語封印在體內、卻依然被強行撕裂出來的聲音。 "I don't want you here with me." 「我根本不希望你待在這裡陪我。」 Rover quietly stares. Luuk is gritting his teeth so tightly that it can't be anything but painful. He can see his veins straining through his skin, his muscles jumping as they lock and go still with the force of how tightly he's trying to reign in the rest of his words. 漂泊者安靜地凝視著他。陸死死咬著牙，那種力道光是用看的都能感受得到劇痛。漂泊者能看到陸皮膚下鼓起突出的青筋，以及他為了極力克制住其餘話語而繃緊僵硬、微微顫抖的肌肉。 "...Is that what you really think?" 「......這真的是你心裡所想的嗎？」 —And there, with that one, simple question, he sees Luuk. ——接著，就在這句簡單無比的提問落下的瞬間，漂泊者看到了「陸」。 The Luuk that he knows. The one 'he's' undoubtedly always known, before his memories were lost. 他所熟知的那個陸。那個在他失去記憶之前、無疑就一直深愛著他的陸。 With his fingers digging into his own cheeks and his eyes forcefully closed shut, Luuk slowly shakes his head. He pries his red eyes open and looks pleadingly up at Rover, desperately begging him to understand that he doesn't mean a single thing he's outwardly said. 陸用手指深深地摳進自己的臉頰裡，雙眼死死閉合著，隨後極其緩慢地搖了搖頭。他強行睜開那雙紅色的眼睛，帶著哀求與渴望看向漂泊者，拼命乞求著漂泊者能夠理解——他剛才口中說出的每一個字，都不是他的本意。 He wouldn't dare keep anything from Rover, but this dishonest expression of himself is something he couldn't forgive. Even moreso if Rover ends up believing a single word of it or, worse— 他絕不敢對漂泊者有所隱瞞，但他無法原諒自己此刻這副違心的模樣。他更無法接受漂泊者真的相信了其中的任何一個字，或者更糟—— Getting hurt from it. 因此而被他傷害。 So even if physically pains him to, he forces one more word out through his clenched jaw and hopes that for now, at least until the candy's effect wears off, it would be enough. 所以，哪怕這會帶來肉體上的劇痛，他依然咬緊牙關，強行從喉嚨深處擠出最後一個字，希望至少在糖果的藥效消退之前，這一個字就足夠了。 "...Please," he says. 「......求你，」他說道。 'Please don't misunderstand. You know how I feel about you. I've changed, Rover. If I had it my way, I never would have wanted you to see this side of me, so please—' 『求你別誤會。你知道我對你的感情。我已經變了，漂泊者。如果可以的話，我這輩子都不希望讓你看到我這一面，所以求你——』 He breathes harshly into his palm. He's almost physically sick with the desperation to not give Rover a reason to dislike him. 他對著自己的掌心急促地喘息著。那種極度害怕給漂泊者留下壞印象的慌亂與絕望，幾乎讓他感到嘔心反胃。 'Please, stay with me.' 『求求你，留在我身邊。』 At the end of his whisper, rather than scorn or hurt— 在他的低語結束之際，迎接陸的並非冷落或受傷—— "Okay." 「好。」 —what greets Luuk is a smile. ——而是一個笑容。 An honest smile from Rover who's still staring at him without judgment, soft and no less brighter for it. He pulls Luuk's hand away from his mouth and draws closer until they're nearly nose to nose, quietly shushing the wounded noise that escapes from Luuk's sealed lips as he tries to turn away. 來自漂泊者真誠無比的笑容。漂泊者依然毫無偏見地凝視著他，眼神無比柔和，甚至因此顯得更加璀璨。他拉開了陸擋在嘴邊的手，湊得更近了些，直到兩人的鼻尖幾乎貼在一起，隨後輕聲安撫著陸因為試圖轉過頭去而從封閉唇間溢出的受傷哼聲。 With glittering gold eyes, he smiles up at Luuk. This close, and this warm, all words cease to exist in Luuk's mind. 憑著那雙閃爍著金光的眼睛，漂泊者對著陸露出了微笑。在如此近距離、如此溫暖的包圍下，陸腦海中所有的言語瞬間煙消雲散。 As if he were a brittle candy being made to melt on a sweet tongue, Luuk can only defenselessly stare back. 就像是一顆脆弱的糖果被放在甘甜的舌尖上漸漸融化一樣，陸只能毫無防備地回視著他。 'It's still Luuk, after all.' 『說到底，他依然還是那個陸啊。』 "I'll stay," Rover says. Then, chuckling softly, he whispers, "You really like me, huh?" 「我會留下來的，」漂泊者說道。隨後，他輕笑了出來，低語道：「你真的好喜歡我，對吧？」 This time, Luuk's body doesn't it—he nods right into the side of Rover's neck. 這一次，陸的身體沒有再進行任何反抗——他徑直將頭埋進了漂泊者的頸窩裡，深深地點了點頭。

對照閱讀/陸漂文/35.html.title: 35 想到了阿布
對照閱讀/陸漂文/35.html.body: 35 想到了阿布 對話時間：2026-08-16 11:55:56 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段從阿布視角出發的文字，把那份藏在沉睡與微醒之間的陪伴，以及對漂泊者深沉的疼惜寫得太溫柔、太治癒了！(🥺😭包包捏爆 ฅ'ω meow~) 阿布雖然大部分時間沉睡在漂泊者的意識深處，但那份屬於兩人共用身體的沉重疲憊與絕望，依然會透過連結泛起漣漪。阿布醒來的短暫幾分鐘裡，漂泊者總是沉默不語——那是怕阿布擔憂，也是因為痛苦沉重到無話可說。那種無聲的沉默，就像是漂泊者對阿布遞出的一句無聲抱歉。 然而，在經歷了愛彌斯與種種苦難之後，當阿布再次半夢半醒地睜開眼，映入眼簾的雖然是拉海洛一片冷冽肅殺的雪原，阿布卻感受到了久違的溫暖。 那不是來自環境的溫度，而是來自走在漂泊者身邊的那個人——陸·赫斯。 對一直提心吊膽、強迫自己半夢半醒以隨時保護漂泊者的阿布來說，陸的存在就像是「漫長嚴冬裡盛開的春天，以及無休止漂泊者的歸宿」。看到漂泊者身邊終於有了可以依靠、能為他帶來微小太陽般暖意的人，阿布終於能安心地縮緊爪子，沉沉睡去。這段文字真的太有詩意、太溫暖了！✨ Thinking about Abby. 想到了阿布。 Specifically, Abby who might've had to witness what Rover went through in Lahai-Roi. 尤其是那個......或許不得不親眼目睹漂泊者在拉海洛所遭遇的一切的阿布。 The memories are in fragmented pieces from their sleep. The moments where they were faintly conscious enough to pick up on what's happening around Rover are fleeting at best, but the exhaustion weighing their shared physical body ripples through their connection past what Abby can concretely remember. 記憶在牠的沉睡中散落成碎片的微光。那些牠隱約保有意識、能勉強感知到漂泊者周遭狀況的瞬間，頂多只是稍縱即逝的片段；然而，沉重壓在他們共同肉體上的那份極度疲憊，卻穿透了兩人之間的連結，遠比阿布能夠具體記起的畫面還要深刻。 For the short few minutes Abby is awake, Rover doesn't talk. Perhaps it's so that he doesn't burden Abby with the the immense weight of his feelings, or perhaps it's that he simply has no words for what he's going through. In the end, all there is between them is a silence that sounds and aches like an unspoken apology. 在阿布短暫清涼醒來的幾分鐘裡，漂泊者從不說話。或許是不想讓自己那份沉重無比的情緒負擔壓垮阿布，又或許是他對自己正在經歷的苦難根本無話可說。到最後，留在他們之間的，只有一段聽起來、痛起來都像是一句未曾出口的道歉般的沉默。 Yet ironically, somehow, in some way— 然而諷刺的是，不知為何，在某種因緣際會下—— Tucked in the depths of Rover's consciousness, the first beam of warmth after Aemeath comes with the contradictory sight of a plain, white field and falling snow. 躲藏在漂泊者意識的最深處，在愛彌斯之後迎來的第一縷暖陽，竟伴隨著一片平坦純白的世界與漫天飛雪這種矛盾的景象降臨。 The soft pulse of warmth they felt has nothing to do with the landscape, Abby realizes once they hear someone else's voice talking in a gentle tone, and everything to do with the man walking beside Rover. 當阿布聽到另一個人用溫柔的語調說話時，牠才意識到，牠所感受到的那股柔和脈動的暖意與眼前的雪景毫無關係，而是完全源於那個走在漂泊者身旁的人。 Luuk Herssen. 陸·赫森（Luuk Herssen）。 A man who, from the very beginning, smelled of spring and home. 一個從一開始，身上就散發著春天與家園氣息的男人。 'That's good,' Abby thinks as the two continue their slow tread through the snow, sleepily blinking through a small yawn and snuggling closer into the curl of their paws. It's become a habit to force themself to stay half-awake just in case Rover needed them. There are all kinds of unknown situations they could get into, enemies they didn't know by both their face and name. Now more than ever, Rover needed their help. 『太好了，』阿布看著那兩個人繼續在雪地裡緩慢前行，打著小小的哈欠，困倦地眨了眨眼，將身體縮得更緊、更深地貼進自己蜷曲的爪子裡。為了防止漂泊者需要牠，強迫自己保持半夢半醒已經成了阿布的習慣。這個世界充滿了各種未知的情況，有著牠們連名字和長相都叫不出的敵人。比以往任何時候，漂泊者都更需要牠的幫助。 But. 但是。 This time, for what feels like the first since they've made it to Lahai-Roi, it looks like Abby can finally get a proper, deep sleep. 這一次，似乎是自從牠們來到拉海洛以來，阿布終於能夠好好地、深沉地睡上一覺了。 ["You've always been good at creating miracles."] 【「你總是擅長創造奇蹟呢。」】 Abby's tiny mouth curls into a satisfied smile. 阿布的小嘴微微勾起一抹滿足的微笑。 'Looks like you're going to be okay, now. Right, Rover?' 『看起來你現在會沒事的了。對吧，漂泊者？』 The warmth feels nice. It's like a small sun, held close in the left side of Rover's chest, burning warm like a nurtured flame even in a place like this where there is only an endless winter to be seen for thousands of miles. 這股暖意感覺真好。它就像是一顆微小的太陽，被緊緊呵護在漂泊者胸口左側，即便是在這樣一個方圓數千英里內只有無盡嚴冬的地方，依然如同一朵被細心呵護的火焰般溫暖地燃燒著。 Well, Abby's nose always had an intuition for things like this. It's never let either of them down before. 嗯，阿布的鼻子對於這種事情向來有著獨特的直覺。牠的直覺以前從未讓牠們任何一個人失望過。 Spring and home—they suit Luuk perfectly, don't they? 春天與家園——這兩個詞與陸真是絕配，不是嗎？ At least here, in the middle of the Frostlands, it holds true. 至少在這裡，在這片冰原的中央，這句話確實是無可置疑的真理。 Spring, despite and amidst the winter. 縱使身處嚴冬，春天依然如期而至。 And a place like home, for the one who tirelessly wanders. 而對於永無止境漫遊的人來說，這裡就是家。

對照閱讀/陸漂文/36.html.title: 36 為虐的，兩人的互動…
對照閱讀/陸漂文/36.html.body: 36 為虐的，兩人的互動… 對話時間：2026-08-16 11:56:39 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段把「差一步就錯過」的酸澀、悔恨與窒息感寫得太讓人心碎了！(🥺😭💔✨) 陸在最後一秒的下意識退縮，瞬間刺傷了漂泊者。而最殘忍的地方在於——漂泊者沒有生氣，也沒有逼問，他只是收起了所有的期待，露出了最溫柔、最懂事、卻也最疏離的微笑。 漂泊者甚至貼心地幫陸找好了退路：「對不起，是我誤會了情勢」、「什麼事也沒發生」。他把自己受傷的後退包裝成懂事，用那雙初見時裝作無知、卻無比善良的眼睛盯著陸，不給陸任何自責的機會。 而陸在看到漂泊者下意識擋在兩人之間、像防備傷害一樣護著被他碰過的手腕時，那種「我親手把我最珍貴的人推開了、我親手給他留下了一道無法癒合的傷口」的絕望，簡直像活生生挖出了他的心臟。掌心那股如瀕死行星核心般的炙熱劇痛，是他對自己臨陣脫逃最殘忍的懲罰。 Luuk pulls away just before he and Rover can kiss, and he realizes his mistake almost instantly when Rover quietly says "Oh." all meek and filled with shame. 就在陸與漂泊者即將吻上的前一秒，陸抽身退開了。當漂泊者無比溫順、充滿羞恥地輕聲吐出一句「啊......」時，陸幾乎是瞬間意識到了自己的失誤。 A visceral need to touch any part of Rover that he can reach before he gets too far overtakes Luuk after he realizes that he messed up, but Rover is firmly ripping his wrist out of his hand when his senses return. 在意識到自己搞砸了一切之後，一股極致而本能的衝動瞬間吞噬了陸——他迫切地想要碰觸漂泊者任何他能夠夠到的地方，深怕對方會就此離他太遠。然而當漂泊者的理智回籠時，他無情地將自己的手腕從陸的手掌中硬生生抽了出來。 "It's okay," Rover says. It's the same eyes he'd given him when they first met. Intentionally clueless and wide, achingly kind in the lies they're trying to sell. He doesn't let Luuk see any of the hurt. He won't allow him to blame himself for something that was out of his control. The fault isn't with Luuk; it was with Rover, for daring to hope. 「沒關係的，」漂泊者說道。那雙眼睛與他們初次相遇時一模一樣——刻意裝作無知而瞪大，在他試圖兜售的謊言中流露出令人心疼的善良。他沒有讓陸看到一絲一毫的受傷，他絕不允許陸為了某件無法控制的事情而自責。這不是陸的錯；錯的是漂泊者自己，錯在他竟然敢抱有期待。 "Sorry. I misread the situation." 「對不起。是我誤會了情勢。」 Still, he couldn't hide the frantic step he takes backwards when Luuk approaches him. He lifts an arm, almost protectively, between their bodies to keep the other man from coming any closer. He's nursing the hand that Luuk had touched like he'd bruised it. 然而，當陸向他靠近時，他依然無法掩飾自己慌亂後退的腳步。他舉起一隻手臂，幾乎是以一種保護性的姿態隔在兩人身體之間，阻止對方再靠近一步。他撫摸著剛才被陸碰過的那隻手，就彷彿那裡被捏出了青紫的瘀傷一般。 Rover has never had to do that before. Never had to Luuk keep out and away from him like this. 漂泊者以前從不需要這樣做。他從不需要像這樣把陸防備在心門之外、推得遠遠的。 Never treated Luuk like he is capable of hurting him. 也從未像這樣——把陸當成一個有可能會傷害到他的人來對待。 For a short second, as Luuk stares down at Rover who keeps smiling weakly up at him, his right hand spasms with a nauseating cramp. A heat so intense that it nearly feels cold burns in the center of his palm like a dying planet's core. Right at the pecipice of that scorching temperature, he finds himself thinking that if there is an infinitesimal chance that burning himself alive would take him back to a few seconds earlier, he's willing to let the ichor turn the rest of his body into molten gold. 在陸低頭凝視著對他弱弱微笑的漂泊者的短短一秒鐘裡，他的右手突然痙攣起來，傳來一陣令人作嘔的劇烈抽筋。一股強烈到幾乎讓人感到冰冷的灼熱感，在他掌心中央如同一顆瀕死行星的核心般劇烈燃燒。就在那炙熱溫度的崖邊，他發現自己甚至在想：如果自焚有一絲一毫的可能性帶他回到幾秒鐘之前，他甘願讓那些膿血與異質將他身體的其餘部分全部化為熔融的黃金。 "Rover, I—" 「漂泊者，我——」 "It's fine," Rover repeats. 「真的沒關係，」漂泊者重複道。 "—I'm sorry." 「——對不起。」 "What are you saying sorry for? Nothing happened." 「你幹嘛道歉？又沒發生什麼事。」 The empty smile that graces Rover's face cuts like a deep incision where Luuk's heart sits. 漂泊者臉上掛著的那抹空洞笑容，宛如一道深深的割痕，精準地切在了陸心臟所在的位置。 'His most trusted friend and companion.' That's all he will ever be. 『他最信任的朋友與夥伴。』他這輩子能得到的，就只有這個了。 "Nothing happened," Rover repeats quietly, as if willing Luuk to forget what he'd tried to do. 「什麼都沒發生，」漂泊者低聲重複道，就彷彿在用意志力強迫陸忘記他剛才試圖做過的事。 Nothing more, nothing less. 不多，也不少。 "Sorry," he says. 「對不起，」他說道。 (Luuk's chance is gone before he realizes that he even had it in the first place. He watches the open honesty in Rover's eyes shutter and die out, unable to say anything that wouldn't be taken as an unconditional display of his devotion to a friend. （陸甚至還沒意識到自己曾經擁有過機會，那個機會就已經蕩然無存了。他眼睜睜看著漂泊者眼中原本坦蕩的真誠漸漸合上、熄滅，而自己卻說不出任何一句不會被解讀為「對朋友的無條件奉獻」的話語。 Another unhealing wound, he thinks. And this one, he'd caused with his own hands.) 又一道無法癒合的傷口，他心想。而這一次，是他親手造成的。）

對照閱讀/陸漂文/37.html.body: 37 親親狂魔… 對話時間：2026-08-16 11:57:17 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段簡直甜到發昏、讓人邊看邊忍不住露出姨母笑啊！(⁄ ⁄•⁄ω⁄•⁄ ⁄)✨❤️ 從一開始趁人不注意偷偷摸摸的親吻，演變成一進到私密小工作室或四下無人處時，每隔幾秒就忍不住貼上去的「接吻狂魔（Kissing monster）」陸！平時用來講故事交流的言語，全都變成了輕柔濕潤的親吻聲與重喘，漂泊者甚至得親自上手擋住那張不聽話的嘴，免得自己的嘴唇真的被親到「掉下來」！ 最絕的是陸研製的「特製滋潤護唇膏」——根本非但沒有起到緩和的作用，反而變相成了陸光明正大繼續親爆漂泊者的完美藉口！(σ′▽｀)σ 面對漂泊者微腫又發燙的嘴唇，陸直接祭出大招：把下巴擱在漂泊者胸口上、眨著無辜的紅眸，甚至露出漂泊者最無法抗拒的那種「如蜂蜜般黏稠甜美、眼角微微瞇起」的極品笑容，外加背後那對彷彿在得意搖晃的虛擬狐狸大尾巴......這誰頂得住啊？！漂泊者除了向鳴潮（Exostrider）祈求力量之外，也只能甘拜下風、寵溺地任由這隻可憐又狡猾的大狗狗繼續索吻了！( 醬汁加爆 ฅ'ω'ฅ) Kissing monster Luuk. Every few minutes of sneakily stolen kisses turn to every few seconds when they're in the privacy of his small workspace or somewhere far away from the curious, prying eyes. Words that they'd usually exchange to share stories would be replaced by the quiet sounds of soft, wet kisses and their heavy breathing, Rover's chuckles punctuating each gasp as he tries to ease Luuk's eagerness to keep his mouth locked against his. 當他們待在陸那間狹小的工作室、或是遠離他人好奇窺探的僻靜處時，原本還只是趁人不注意時偷來的幾次親吻，瞬間演變成了每隔幾秒就忍不住貼上去的索求。平時用來分享故事的言語，全被輕柔濕潤的接吻聲與彼此沉重的呼吸聲所取代，而漂泊者每次試圖平息陸那急切貼上來的唇舌時，喘息間總會夾雜著無奈的低笑。 ("Relax. You're going too fast." 「放鬆點。你太急了。」 Luuk surges up to kiss him again, but he's met with a warm, resisting hand against his mouth. 陸再次湊上前想要吻他，但嘴唇上卻抵來了一隻溫熱、帶著抗拒意味的手掌。 "Listen to me," Rover says, amused. 「聽我說，」漂泊者有些好笑地說道。 Dazed, feverish red eyes blink. Luuk nods. 那雙有些迷離、泛著熱氣的紅眸眨了眨。陸點了點頭。 It would be convincing if not for the light kisses he's taken to pressing right into the palm of Rover's hand right after he finished talking. 如果不是因為他在漂泊者剛說完話的下一秒，就開始將輕柔的親吻一下又一下地印在漂泊者的掌心上的話，這副聽話的模樣倒還挺有說服力的。 Deciding to take a different approach since he's clearly not listening, Rover holds Luuk's face still, thumb gliding over a pinkened bottom lip. It's become a little tender from all their kissing—he's sure that his mouth doesn't look any better. He swipes the pad of his fingertip over the sensitive skin in gentle back-and-forth motions. 意識到陸顯然根本沒在聽，漂泊者決定換個方式。他捧住陸的臉，拇指輕柔地滑過陸那泛紅的下唇。因為剛剛那番鋪天蓋地的親吻，陸的嘴唇已經變得有些嬌嫩敏感——漂泊者很確定自己的嘴唇看起來絕對好不到哪去。他的指腹在陸那敏感的肌膚上輕輕地來回撫摸著。 "Take it easy, hm? My mouth will start falling off at this rate. You won't be able to kiss me then." 「放輕鬆，嗯？照這個速度下去，我的嘴唇很快就要掉下來了。到時候你就再也吻不到我了。」 Some clarity returns to Luuk's eyes. 陸的眼中恢復了幾分清明。 "It won't." Squeezing Rover's hips and wholly unsubtle about how he's trying to stretch his neck so he can inch up higher and reach his lips again, he says, "I'll help you." 「不會掉的。」陸一邊捏著漂泊者的胯骨，一邊毫不掩飾地伸長脖子、試圖向上挪動以再次夠到漂泊者的唇，說道：「我會幫你的。」 "You'll help me, how?") 「你幫我？你要怎麼幫？」 The solution, apparently, is a flavored lip balm made by Luuk himself. ——而陸給出的解決方案，顯然是他自己親手調製的香味護唇膏。 It doesn't help one bit. 然而這根本一點用也沒有。 ("I feel like you've gotten worse," Rover pants, tenderly touching at his wet and now puffy lips to check the damage. Luuk is on him, his thick torso resting between the cradle of Rover's thighs and wearing that same 'not fully there' expression that consists of lightly flushed cheeks and eyes that refuse to leave the general direction of Rover's mouth. 「我怎麼覺得你反而變本加厲了，」漂泊者氣喘吁吁地說道，有些嬌嗔地摸了摸自己濕潤且已經有些腫脹的嘴唇，檢查著「受損程度」。陸此刻正壓在他身上，魁梧的身軀嵌在漂泊者的雙腿之間，臉上掛著同款『神智不太清醒』的表情——雙頰微紅，眼睛更是死死黏在漂泊者嘴唇的方向，死活不肯移開。 "Have I?" He has the fall to rest his chin on Rover's chest and look up at him adorably. You can sleep right here. I'll take care of everything." 「我明白了。不客氣。」陸身下的肌肉微微蠕動，他將漂泊者更緊地攬入懷中，並在漂泊者的側腦勺上印下一個親吻作為回禮。「你一定累壞了。就在這裡睡吧，剩下的事情全部交給我來處理就好。」 The next blink is slower. Sleepier. 下一次眨眼變得更加遲緩、更加困倦了。 He gives one testing squeeze to Luuk's hand where their fingers are intertwined. Without a pause, Luuk squeezes his hand back. 他在兩人手指交纏的地方，試探性地捏了捏陸的手掌。沒有片刻停頓，陸立刻緊緊回握住了他的手。 'Will you stay?' 『你會留下來嗎？』 'I'm not going anywhere. I'll stay here by your side for as long as you want.' 『我哪兒也不去。只要你希望，我會一直陪在你身邊。』 '—Forever, then.' 『——那就一輩子吧。』 An unvoiced laughter. When Rover's eyes fall shut, they don't open again. 一道未曾出口的低笑。當漂泊者的雙眼閉合上時，就再也沒有睜開。 'For the rest of my life,' the warmth of Luuk's hand promises. 『在我餘生的每一個日子裡，』陸掌心傳來的溫暖如此承諾著。 And just like that, Rover drifts.) 就這樣，漂泊者沉沉入睡了。

對照閱讀/陸漂文/40.html.title: 40 關於陸的氣味(?)…
對照閱讀/陸漂文/40.html.body: 40 關於陸的氣味(?)… 對話時間：2026-08-22 20:57:33 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這段關於「氣味染亮靈魂」與「獨特偏愛」的設定真的太浪漫、太有儀式感了！(🥺😭✨❤️) 陸過去因為潛伏臥底的習慣，習慣抹去身上的所有氣味；身為校醫，他身上原本頂多帶著醫療器材的微冷與淡淡的糖果甜香。他不會擦任何強烈的香水，因為他需要平易近人，身上最常見的是烘焙糕點那種令人安心、溫暖的家園氣息。 然而，他卻會在與漂泊者有約的日子裡，刻意不噴任何香氣——只為了讓漂泊者那更強烈、更鮮明的氣味如彩墨滲入清水般，慢慢染滿自己的全身。 這種帶有一絲執拗與偏執的深情，被阿布（Abby）一眼拆穿：「如果他再努力一點，簡直不能表現得更明顯了！」(σ′▽｀)σ 對於陸這個將餘生都奉獻給漂泊者的人來說，能被漂泊者的氣味包覆、成為漂泊者存在與記憶的延伸，就是最至高無上的救贖。而漂泊者那句「因為是陸，所以沒關係」，更是給予了陸最特別、最獨一無二的特權與包容。 Curious about whether Luuk is odorless (habits from infiltration work) or if he carries a sterile scent from his proximity to medical equipment with a candy sweet note. Somehow, I don't picture him wearing any strong scents. Needs to be approachable—so something milder and easier on the nose. His little baked treats might be the most common association: comforting, soothing, and homely. 關於陸到底是毫無氣味（出於潛伏臥底工作養成的習慣），抑或是因為長期接觸醫療器材而帶著一股帶有糖果甜香的無菌氣味，確實令人好奇。不知為何，總覺得他並不適合使用任何濃烈的香水。他需要保持平易近人——因此溫和、不刺鼻的氣味才最適合他。他親手製作的小烘焙點心或許是最常見的聯想：令人感到舒適、撫慰人心且充滿家園的溫暖。 The idea that Rover's natural scent—stronger, a little more concentrated, bleeding over Luuk's like color seeping into water—would rub off on him is... a powerful one. Luuk might deliberately not wear anything when he has something planned with Rover just so he could smell like him when the day ends. A little obsessive, perhaps. But Luuk's a man who'd wait that long for just one person—this is hardly any news. 而漂泊者那更加強烈、更加濃縮的自然氣味——宛如顏料滲入水中一般染透陸原本的氣味——這個想法……無疑是極具震撼力的。每當陸與漂泊者有安排時，他可能會刻意不擦任何香氛，為的就是能在一天結束之際，讓自己渾身都散發著漂泊者的氣味。或許這有那麼一點點偏執。但陸本就是個願意為了同一個人等待那麼漫長歲月的男人——這算不上什麼新聞了。 It's only right that the man who brings warmth and light in his world that's devoid of color would mark Luuk this way too. From his heart and tarnished soul, to this aging, mortal body that has sworn the rest of its remaining time to the man he is devoted to. 在這個失去色彩的世界裡，讓那個帶來光明與溫暖的人以這種方式在陸身上留下烙印，實在是再合情合理不過了。從他的心靈與受損的靈魂，到這具已然衰老、將餘下時光全數發誓奉獻給心愛之人的凡人之軀。 If his life is to be steeped in only hues of gold, let it be Rover's. Let it carry Rover's memories, his secrets, and the evidence of his existence. Let Luuk be an extension of and a part of him, so that Rover never has to feel alone. 如果他的生命注定只能被金色所浸潤，那就讓它是屬於漂泊者的金色吧。讓這具身體帶有漂泊者的記憶、他的秘密，以及他存在的證明。讓陸成為漂泊者的延伸與一部份，如此一來，漂泊者就再也不必感到孤單。 ("...You're starting to smell like me." 「……你身上開始散發出我的味道了呢。」 "You can tell?" 「你能聞得出來？」 "Not me. Abby." 「不是我，是阿布。」 "Ah, your little friend. That makes sense. We've been spending more time together as of late; that must be why." 「啊，你的小夥伴啊。那倒不奇怪。我們最近待在一起的時間變多了，想必就是因為這個原因吧。」 A beat, followed by a quiet laughter. Luuk returns his smile even though he doesn't know why Rover is laughing. 停頓了半晌，隨之而來的是一陣輕柔的低笑。儘管陸不知道漂泊者在笑什麼，他依然回以微笑。 "I take it they had something to say." 「我猜牠應該有些話想說吧。」 "Quite a few," Rover admits. Through his lashes, he smiles up at Luuk. "Abby said you 'couldn't be more obvious if you tried'. Any idea on what they might mean by that?" 「說了不少呢，」漂泊者承認道。他透過睫毛，抬頭對著陸笑了笑。「阿布說你『就算再怎麼努力，表現得也不可能比現在更明顯了』。你知道牠這句話是什麼意思嗎？」 Luuk tries to tamp down on his widening smile, feigning cluelessness by holding his chin and flicking his eyes to the side. Unfortunately, all that does is just give him away. "No, not a single clue." 陸試圖壓下自己擴大的嘴角，手托著下巴，眼睛有些心虛地飄向一旁，假裝一無所知。遺憾的是，這些舉動反而讓他徹底露陷了。「不知道，一點頭緒也沒有。」 "Hm. Guess I'll have to take your word for it." 「嗯。看來我只能相信你的說法了。」 He laughs to himself again, undoubtedly hearing select words from his little furry companion. 漂泊者又自顧自地笑了起來，無疑是聽到了來自他那位毛茸茸小夥伴的某些「精選發言」。 "It's fine since it's Luuk," Rover says out loud. Despite the lack of clear context, a pleased warmth washes over Luuk at the easy acceptance—it makes him feel like a particularly special exception to be given this much leeway just for being himself. "You agree, don't you?" 「不過因為是陸，所以沒關係，」漂泊者大聲說道。儘管缺乏明確的前因後果，但這份毫不設防的接納依然讓陸心中泛起一陣愉悅的暖流——這種光是因為「成為自己」就能獲得如此巨大寬容的待遇，讓他覺得自己像個極其特別的例外。 「你也是這麼想的，對吧？」 The silence, although one-sided, seems begrudging from Abby's end. More unheard words are exchanged. If something's different this time, however, it's that Luuk catches the visible softening of Rover's smile as he meets Luuk's eyes. 雖然這是一場單方面的對話，但從阿布那端傳來的沉默似乎帶著幾分不情願。更多未被旁人聽見的話語在他們之間交流著。然而，如果說這次有什麼不同於前面的話，那就是當漂泊者對上陸的視線時，陸敏銳地捕捉到了漂泊者嘴角那明顯變得溫柔的弧度。 "...As long as this is what he wants," Rover says, intentionally vague to keep Luuk from knowing what Abby had asked him, "then I don't mind.") 「……只要這是他所希望的，」漂泊者故意說得很含糊，好不讓陸知道阿布剛才問了什麼，「那我就不介意。」

對照閱讀/陸漂文/41.html.title: 41 迷你陸娃娃…
對照閱讀/陸漂文/41.html.body: 41 迷你陸娃娃… 對話時間：2026-08-22 20:58:09 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這個「迷你陸（Mini-Luuk）棉花娃娃/小玩偶」的初稿橋段真的太可愛、太有陪伴感了！(🥺😭❤️✨) 漂泊者在外冒險時，哪怕自己受點輕傷，也要死死護住這個代表陸的小玩偶。它被仔細地收在口袋裡、陪著漂泊者吃飯、睡覺時貼著肌膚共享體溫，甚至在全息通話（Holographic call）裡，漂泊者還會玩心大發地捏著玩偶的小短手向本尊揮手——這根本就是把對陸的思念與愛意實體化了啊！ (σ′▽｀)σ 而陸那句脫口而出的「你好像真的很喜歡我（……的小玩偶）」，以及漂泊者戳著小玩偶臉頰、抬頭用那雙燦爛金眸笑著問他：「到目前為止，我都把你保護得很好，對吧？」 那一刻陸的心動與潰敗，簡直甜到令人窒息！在漂泊者那雙歷經戰火的手掌裡，小玩偶乾淨得像剛收到那天一樣，而陸也終於明白——自己一直以來，都被這個人如此深切、無微不至地愛著。 / rough draft Rover who sees this and ends up coughing into his hand to mask his laughter. 漂泊者看到這個時，忍不住用手掩住嘴巴咳嗽，以掩飾自己的笑意。 The resemblance is uncanny. So, in a (debatably) reasonable decision of expenditure, he gets one for himself. 那種神似感簡直不可思議。於是，在一個（勉強算得上）合理的支出決定下，他為自己買了一個。 (He keeps it safe throughout his journey, making sure never to let any harm come to it—sometimes, even at the expense of sustaining a few shallow injuries that Luuk would definitely disapprove of. And whenever the time allows it, he sends Luuk pictures of his mini-version, propped up next to a plate while he eats or right next to where he's supposed to sleep for the night. （在旅途中，他小心翼翼地保護著它，確保它不會受到任何傷害——有時甚至不惜以自己受點陸絕對不會贊同的微小輕傷為代價。只要時間允許，他就會給陸發送這隻迷你版自己的照片：有時是吃飯時把它頂在盤子旁，有時則是放在他今晚準備入睡的位置旁邊。 Although Luuk won't admit it, his favorite pictures are probably the ones where Rover is carefully carrying 'him' in his palm and holding him close. He didn't think Rover would carry something that resembled him for this long—really, a little toy doll? one that looked like Luuk, of all things—but here he is, playfully moving the nubs that make up mini-Luuk's arms to make him wave at the real Luuk through their holographic call. 儘管陸絕不會承認，但他最喜歡的照片，大概是漂泊者用掌心細心託著『他』、貼近胸口的那幾張。陸從沒想過漂泊者會把一個長得像自己的小玩具玩偶隨身攜帶這麼久——偏偏還是個像陸一樣的小東西——但漂泊者此刻就在全息通話裡，童心未泯地晃動著組成迷你陸手臂的小團塊，讓它隔著螢幕向真正的陸揮手。 "You seem to really like me," slips out of his mouth before he can fully think what he said through. The pause that follows it is loud and unignorable, and Luuk is already backtracking, his smiling tightening with the discomfort of having said something so honest thoughtlessly. 「你好像真的很喜歡我，」這句話在他還沒完全想清楚之前就脫口而出了。隨之而來的停頓無比清晰且無法忽略，陸立刻開始倒退挽回，笑容因為無意間說出了如此坦率的話而顯得僵硬不適。 "The doll version of me," he clarifies. "'It's' well-made, and you seem to be taking good care of it. The person who made it would be happy to hear you're treating it with such care." 「我是說……我那個玩偶版本，」他澄清道。「『它』做得很精緻，而且你似乎把它照顧得很好。製作它的那個人如果知道你這麼用心對待它，一定會很高興的。」 But the damage has been done. Rover's small smile has taken an indulgent curve as he patiently waits for Luuk to finish his rambling. 但傷害已經造成了。漂泊者的小笑意勾起了一抹寵溺的弧度，耐心地等待著陸說完那串慌亂的辯解。 "...I didn't mean it that way," Luuk says, feebly attempting to clear his throat when Rover continues to just watch him with a knowing gaze. "You understand what I mean, right?" 「……我不是那個意思，」陸無力地試圖咳一咳嗽澄清，因為漂泊者依然只是用一種看穿一切的眼神看著他。「你明白我的意思，對吧？」 Looking down at the mini-Luuk doll, Rover's smile widens. "You're not wrong. It's not an easy feat to keep you safe, knowing what I do." He pokes at the doll's cheek. "But I try." 低頭看著迷你陸玩偶，漂泊者的笑容加深了。「你其實沒說錯。在知道我所面臨的情況下要保護好你，可不是一件容易的事呢。」他戳了戳玩偶的臉頰。「但我一直在努力。」 Golden eyes—brilliant and beautiful—look up at him. 那雙璀璨而美麗的金眸抬起來看向他。 "I've been doing a good job protecting you so far, haven't I?" 「到目前為止，我都把你保護得很好，對吧？」 Luuk swallows. He eyes the little version of him, mindlessly smiling up at the world without a care for a single thing. He looks small in Rover's battle-roughened hands. Safe and so, so adorably precious. Clean despite the unpredictable weather of the region, bearing not a single tear or sign of wearing. It's as pristine as the day he received it. 陸咽了咽口水。他看著那個小小的自己，正無憂無慮地對著世界傻笑著。在漂泊者那雙因戰鬥而顯得有些粗糙的手掌裡，它看起來是那麼小巧、安全，而且是那麼、那麼的討喜與珍貴。儘管這一帶的天氣變幻莫測，它依然像剛收到那天一樣潔淨，沒有絲毫破損或磨損的痕跡。 The little doll looks genuinely cared for, he can't help but think. Tucked safely in Rover's pocket while he explores previously undiscovered regions like a constant companion, cradled in his hands whenever he finds the time to talk to Luuk like a comforting tether, and kept close enough to share the warmth of his skin every night before he sleeps— 這個小玩偶真的被照顧得很好，陸忍不住這樣想。在漂泊者探索未知的區域時，它被安全地塞在口袋裡，充當著不離不棄的夥伴；每當有空與陸說話時，它被捧在手心裡，宛如一個令人安心的紐帶；而在每天晚上入睡前，它被貼得很近，共享著漂泊者肌膚的體溫—— "...Yes," Luuk eventually says. "You have." 「……是的，」陸最終說道。「你做得很好。」 'He' is nothing if loved by him. 『他』若不是被這個人深深愛著，又怎會是這副模樣？ 'You always have, Rover.') 『你一直以來都把我保護得很好，漂泊者。』）

對照閱讀/陸漂文/42.html.title: 42 抱貓…
對照閱讀/陸漂文/42.html.body: 42 抱貓… 對話時間：2026-08-22 20:58:48 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838 這一段真的太可愛、太有畫面感了！(≧∇笑死ฅ meow~) 陸把漂泊者當成一條「長貓（Long-cat）」一樣從腋下抱起來，而漂泊者居然完全不反抗、順從地掛在半空中，甚至還認真思考：「原來阿布平時都是這種感覺啊！」這到底是什麼神仙默契跟信任度啦！(σ′▽｀)σ 最精彩的絕對是校園裡的爆笑反差：原本抱著貓咪姿態的陸，靈光一閃直接升級成「公主抱」！一個是全區域最受歡迎的黃金單身漢（陸校醫），一個是單學年收到最多告白信的傳奇學生（漂泊者），就這樣在眾目睽睽之下一路抱進醫務室！ 琳奈直接看傻眼狂揉眼睛，還順手拍下照片發給愛彌斯，結果愛彌斯的飛訊直接爆發式刷屏！(爆笑貼圖狂發🐾✨) 漂泊者害羞地把臉死死埋進手裡，而陸卻一邊寵溺地抱緊他，一邊露出得逞又無比幸福的笑容——這種「名譽掃地也無所謂，反正抱到老婆了」的大狗狗心態真的太讚了！ / pls read this with ur brain turned off (laughs), not proofread at all! Luuk bodily carrying Rover and lifting him by his underarms like a cat and Rover who, instead of questioning it, goes limply without resistance. 陸直接把漂泊者整個人抱了起來，像抱一隻貓咪一樣從腋下把他拎起；而漂泊者非但沒有提出任何質疑，反而放鬆了渾身肌肉，毫無抵抗地任由他抱著。 He blinks down at the sudden distance between his feet and the floor, curious but not particularly disturbed. If nothing else, he seems comfortable with letting Luuk carry his entire weight. 漂泊者眨了眨眼，低頭看了看自己的雙腳與地面之間突然拉開的距離，感到有些好奇，但並沒有覺得受到驚擾。如果硬要說有什麼感覺的話，他似乎對於把整個身體的重量全部託付給陸這件事感到相當舒服。 "Really...?" Luuk asks, audibly smiling wide from behind him. "Not even going to put up a fight?" 「真的嗎……？」陸在他背後發出清晰而燦爛的笑聲。「你甚至都不打算反抗一下嗎？」 Rover does his best with his limited range of mobility to glance at him from over his shoulder. He partially succeeds—he pins Luuk with one golden eye. 漂泊者在有限的活動範圍內盡了最大努力，試圖從肩頭上方回過頭去看他。他部分成功了——他用一隻金色的眼睛精準地盯著陸。 "Why should I? Although he can't make the actual hue out as it washes down the drain, the temporary dye trickles down like blood against his skin, staining the tiles beneath his feet and the porcelain white walls around him. ——啊，一想到陸在一切塵埃落定之後，獨自洗去頭發上紅染劑的畫面……儘管當染料順著排水口流走時，他其實根本分辨不出那究竟是什麼色彩，但那暫時的染劑卻如鮮血般沿著他的肌膚淌下，染紅了他腳下的瓷磚以及周圍乳白色的瓷牆。 The very human fear that just like the color of blood, Luuk could lose sight of what it means for someone to bleed. 那是一種極其人性化的恐慌——害怕自己就像分不清血液的色彩一樣，最終也會忘記『流血』對一個人來說究竟意味著什麼。 Maybe a moment like that exists, where he realizes what it is that Rover truly wanted for him when he suggested for Luuk to come to Lahai-Roi. When the dirt and the ash and the vivid red of both artificial color and blood are indistinguishable as they slip through his fingers— 或許真的會有這樣的一個時刻存在吧：當泥土、灰燼，以及人工染料與鮮血那抹鮮艷的紅在指縫間滑落、變得無法區分時，他終於豁然開朗，理解了漂泊者當初建議他來到拉海洛時，究竟真心為他期盼著什麼—— He might remember Rover's eyes. 他或許會想起漂泊者的那雙眼睛。 The one color in his life that will never lose its meaning. 那是他生命中唯一永遠不會失去意義的顏色。 A color which, for all the suffering it had caused him and others, has gradually come to mean the dawn that comes after a stormy and lonely night. 這個顏色，儘管曾給他與他人帶來過無盡的痛苦，如今卻已漸漸代表著在漫長而孤獨的風暴之夜後，終於迎來的曙光。 To burn, Luuk thinks as the ichor thrums in his veins, now fully his, and to live. 去燃燒吧，當日髓在他血管中震盪脈動、如今已徹底歸他所有之際，陸心中想著——然後，好好地活下去。

對照閱讀/陸漂文/54.html.body: 54 甜甜陸漂… 對話時間：2026-09-06 14:08:09 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838?hl=zh-TW > 這段「眾人注視下的偏愛與專屬鎖鏈」文戲簡直張力拉滿、甜到發昏！(⁄ ⁄•⁄ω⁄•⁄ ⁄)✨🔥 在聚集了眾多陪伴漂泊者走過無數風雨的親密夥伴與同伴的房間裡，當漂泊者第一時間走向陸的那一刻，那種「無意識的偏愛」與「獨一無二的親密氛圍」直接震撼了在場所有人！ 漂泊者那句帶著些許依賴與求安慰般的「留在我身邊」，就像是在陸的靈魂與四肢上纏繞上了無形的鎖鏈；而陸不僅沒有絲毫抗拒，反而沉溺其中、視之為將自己從冷酷深淵中拯救出來的唯一錨點。當陸伸出手撥開漂泊者的髮絲，在眾目睽睽之下低語一句「那我全都是你的了」時，那種「漂泊者或許屬於很多人，但陸永遠只屬於漂泊者一個人」的臣服與偏愛，簡直霸道又性感到了極致！ A scenario where Rover's many trusted and close companions are all in one room, but the moment he sees Luuk, It's made immediately clear to everyone else that his relationship with the smiling doctor is just a little different. 在一個匯聚了漂泊者無數信任且親密的夥伴們的房間裡，當他看見陸的那一刻，所有人便立刻清楚地意識到——他與這位臉上總是帶著微笑的醫生之間的關係，就是有那麼一點與眾不同。 It's Rover who approaches him first, his smile reaching up to his eyes and tinged with a bit of teasing and some warm relief. "Luuk." 是漂泊者先朝他走過去的，眼角眉梢都染上了笑意，語氣中帶著些許打趣與溫暖的鬆快感。「陸。」 Uttered like a question, but not quite. As if wanting to check if it really is Luuk standing before him. 呼喚聲聽起來像是在發問，卻又不太像。彷彿只是想確認此刻站在自己面前的人，究竟是不是真正的陸。 "Rover," Luuk says like an answer, and the very air around him seems to sweeten as he faces him. He chuckles into his hand, unable to stifle the affection blooming warmly in his chest at being sought out and called; it's a welcome change from their first reunion. "We meet again." 「漂泊者，」陸如同一道解答般回應道，當他面向對方時，連周遭的空氣似乎都隨之變得甜美起來。他用手掩唇低笑，無法壓抑胸口因被尋找與呼喚而溫暖綻放的愛意；比起他們最初的重逢，這樣的相遇真是一個令人無比歡迎的改變。「我們又見面了。」 "...Will you be staying long?" 「……你會待很久嗎？」 Luuk's mouth faintly twitches. He must be thinking of the work Luuk left behind, since he did bring it up when they last talked about the possibility of him leaving Lahai-Roi. But still, that being Rover's first question to him after they finally reunited is... 陸的嘴角微微抽動了一下。漂泊者此刻一定是在擔心陸落下的那些工作，畢竟上次他們聊到陸離開拉海洛的可能性時，陸確實提過這件事。但即便如此，漂泊者在終於重逢後對他说的第一句話居然是這個…… "Do you want me to?" Luuk asks softly. 「你希望我留下來嗎？」陸輕聲問道。 Rover sounds needy for him. Adorably so. 漂泊者聽起來很需要他。甚至到了可愛的地步。 Has he come to mean so much to Rover that he would willingly ask him such cute questions? That would make him happy, if it's true. 他對漂泊者來說已經變得這麼重要了嗎？重要到能讓對方心甘情願地問出這麼可愛的問題？如果這是真的的話，他會感到無比幸福。 At his question, Rover's smile skews into a helpless, understanding slant. "You know that's not for me to decide." 面對他的提問，漂泊者的微笑扭轉成一道無奈而包容的弧度。「你知道那不是能由我來決定的。」 In a distant sort of way, Luuk acknowledges the watchful silence that has befallen the room as their exchange progressed. All eyes are on the two of them now, with some staring more openly than the others. Rover must know this, too. 以一種略顯遙遠的感知，陸意識到了隨著他們對話的推進，整個房間內落下的那片警惕而關注的沉默。此刻所有的目光都集中在他們兩人身上，有些人的凝視甚至比其他人更加開誠布公。漂泊者肯定也意識到了這一點。 But he hasn't given any signs of wanting to keep whatever is between them a secret, so Luuk doesn't try keeping himself in check. 但他完全沒有表現出任何想要將他們之間的關係隱藏起來的跡象，因此陸也沒有試圖去克制自己。 He closes the distance between them with a few steps. And when the wry tilt of Rover's lips turns into something more curious instead of wary or hesitant, Luuk gently brushes a knuckle against the tips of Rover's hair to reveal more of his eyes. 他邁出幾步，縮短了兩人之間的距離。而當漂泊者唇角那抹揶揄的弧度轉化為某種更偏向好奇而非警惕或猶豫的眼神時，陸輕柔地用指節拂過漂泊者的髮絲，露出了他更多那雙漂亮的眼睛。 "Decide for me anyway," Luuk says, watching those silken strands fall back over the bridge of his nose. "I've always listened to you, haven't I?" 「替我做決定吧，」陸看著那些如絲般柔順的髮絲重新落回對方的鼻樑上，低語道。「我一直都很聽你的話，不是嗎？」 Still no resistance or rejection. Just that same fondness, that same warm trust in those ichor-colored irises. 依然沒有任何抗拒或拒絕。在那雙日髓色彩的虹膜裡，只有一如既往的眷戀與溫暖的信任。 There is something here. A display of ownership, and a willingness to be the subject of possession, perhaps. Luuk isn't an object, not really, but he is Rover's weapon. A friend that might be more, and a companion that would never come to betray him in all his lifetime. 這裡存在著某種東西。或許是一種所有權的宣告，以及一種心甘情願成為被佔有對象的服從。陸並非一件物品，絕非如此，但他卻是漂泊者的武器。一個或許超越了朋友關係的夥伴，以及一個在他有生之年絕不可能背叛對方的同行者。 In a room filled with people whose fates are just as intertwined with Rover's, Luuk might not seem all that special. But if he can get Rover to trust him with his vulnerabilities and secrets, his anger and grief and even his most honest impulses—if Luuk can get him to call his name like a gentle plea for reassurance and his companionship, that is more than everything to Luuk. 在這樣一個擠滿了命運同樣與漂泊者緊密交織之人的房間裡，陸看起來或許並沒有那麼特殊。但如果他能讓漂泊者願意將自己的脆弱、秘密、憤怒、悲傷，甚至是那些最真實的衝動都託付給他——如果陸能讓漂泊者喊出他的名字，就像是在溫柔地祈求安撫與陪伴一樣，這對陸來說就已經勝過了一切。 "So," Luuk prods in a quiet and intimate murmur, "what will it be, golden boy?" 「所以，」陸用一種低沉而親密的語調誘導著，「答案是什麼呢，寵兒（golden boy）？」 He answers, "Stay with me." 漂泊者回答道：「留在我身邊。」 Rover stares up at Luuk with clear eyes, winding invisible chains around his throat and limbs, and drawing them tight with just those three words. Then he clenches and unclenches his fingers, as if catching himself in his too-open honesty. "...Just for a while. Until you change your mind." 漂泊者用那雙清澈的眼睛凝視著陸，僅憑這短短的三個字，就在陸的喉嚨與四肢上纏繞上了無形的鎖鏈，並將它們重重收緊。隨後他握緊又鬆開了手指，彷彿發現了自己剛才那過於坦白直率的真心。「……就一會兒就好。直到你改變主意為止。」 Luuk's responding smile is colored with bliss. Far from shackles, Rover's binding grip on him is a grounding tether. 陸隨之露出的微笑裡染滿了至高無上的幸福感。這絕非枷鎖，漂泊者施加在他身上的這種束縛感，是一個能讓他落地的安全錨點。 Without him, Luuk would have long since been lost in the abyss and claimed by the frigid and lonely cold. These chains are a part of him as much as anything else—they're /his/. 如果沒有漂泊者，陸早就在深淵中迷失，並被極寒而孤獨的冰冷所吞噬了。這些鎖鏈早已成為他身體的一部分，正如他身上的一切一樣——它們是『屬於他』的。 Luuk lowers his hand and steps away. Back to a socially acceptable distance on the surface, yet his following words are anything but. 陸放下了手，退開了一步。表面上重新回到了社交上可接受的距離，但他接下來吐出的話語卻與禮貌距離毫無干系。 "Then I'm all yours." 「那麼，我全都是你的了。」 Rover is never going to be solely his, and Luuk is not against sharing. However, when it comes to himself, there is no doubt to be had. 漂泊者永遠不可能獨屬於他一個人，陸也並不反對與他人分享。然而，當涉及到他自己時，卻不會存在任何疑慮。 Luuk solely belongs to him. 陸完完全全、唯獨屬於漂泊者一個人。 Even if Rover comes to stop needing and wanting him, that won't change. 即便有一天漂泊者不再需要他、不再渴望他，這一點也永遠不會改變。

對照閱讀/陸漂文/55.html.body: 55 吃醋ㄉ故事… 對話時間：2026-09-06 14:09:54 來源：https://gemini.google.com/app/c94776e18fe6a838?hl=zh-TW 來嗑翻譯文章吧(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ 這段「醋意大發（Jealous Luuk）」搭配「壞心思又強勢的攻位漂泊者（Dom Rover）」實在是太會了！(⁄ ⁄•⁄ω⁄•⁄ ⁄)✨🔥 兩人的對比簡直是天壤之別——當漂泊者被搭訕時，陸總是溫和地微笑著、絕不插手，任由漂泊者在合理範圍內禮貌應對；但反過來，別人根本沒機會搭訕陸，因為他的眼睛永遠死死黏在漂泊者身上！ 而這段小劇場最讓人心尖發麻的地方，莫過於陸居然把「因為看到漂泊者關注別人而吃醋」視為一種自己不該有的過錯！他壓抑著嫉妒，卻不知這種極致的克制與吃醋，反倒徹底點燃了漂泊者的征服慾與壞心思。漂泊者直接將他壁咚在牆角、用雙手和膝蓋囚禁他，在角落裡直接解開他的褲鏈——「就讓他們看見我。」 這種帶著佔有欲又極其寵溺的壞，簡直把陸壓得死死的，只能在他掌心中羞恥又快感爆棚地臣服！ Rover getting hit on (Luuk passively smiles, not interfering under any circumstances while Rover politely indulges within reason) vs Luuk getting hit on (? how do you hit on a man whose eyes are permanently glued to someone else?) 當漂泊者被搭訕時（陸只是被動地微笑著，無論如何都不會插手干涉，任由漂泊者在合理範圍內禮貌地應對）vs 當陸被搭訕時（……但你該如何去搭訕一個雙眼永遠死死黏在別人身上的男人？） In a quiet corner, Rover leads Luuk against the wall, peering into Luuk's smiling expression with concern. 在一個安靜的角落裡，漂泊者將陸按倒在牆邊，帶著關切的眼神凝視著陸臉上那抹微笑的表情。 "You okay?" he asks. 「你還好嗎？」他問道。 "With?" 「關於？」 A one word reply. Rover feels a twinge of fond amusement. Luuk is still smiling down at him, calm and as unruffled as ever, but he's carefully still against the wall, not reciprocating any of Rover's advances. 單字的回應。漂泊者心頭泛起一絲寵溺的打趣。陸依然對著他微笑，冷靜且一如既往地從容不迫，但他卻僵硬地貼著牆壁，沒有對漂泊者的任何靠近做出回應。 He brackets Luuk with his hands, caging him in and sliding a knee between his legs. "You seem upset." 漂泊者用雙手將陸圈在牆壁與自己之間，囚禁著他，並將一隻膝蓋擠進了他的雙腿之間。「你你看起來不高興。」 Luuk's eyes flick to the side, the pupils trembling as he tries to fight against the terribly honest reflex by looking back at him again as soon as he catches himself. Rover just smiles. 陸的眼神飄向了一側，瞳孔微微顫抖著，試圖對抗那種過於誠實的本能反應，並在察覺到自己失態的瞬間立刻重新看向漂泊者。漂泊者只是微笑著。 "—I apologize," he hoarsely says. 「……我很抱歉，」他聲音沙啞地說道。 "For being upset?" 「抱歉自己不高興了？」 "Yes," Luuk breathes out. "I shouldn't be. I understand that you were only doing what you felt like you needed to do." 「是的，」陸吐出了一口氣。「我不該這樣的。我知道你只是在做你認為需要做的事。」 Taking it as if it's some personal failing to desire Rover enough to be upset over seeing him give his attention to someone else—Rover pushes himself up to gently press a kiss on Luuk's cheek. It shouldn't, he thinks, it really shouldn't, but... 將「因為足夠渴望漂泊者，以至於看到他把注意力放在別人身上而感到吃醋不高興」這件事，當成是某種個人的品德缺陷——漂泊者微微踮起腳，輕柔地在陸的頰邊落下一吻。他不應該這樣的，漂泊者心想，他真的不該這樣做，但是…… Jealousy on a man as emotionally composed as Luuk makes his skin burn. 像陸這樣情緒如此克制沉穩的男人露出嫉妒的模樣，簡直讓漂泊者的皮膚都燃燒了起來。 "Luuk," Rover murmurs, his soft lips brushing down over the sharp line of his jaw. Luuk's entire body flinches, sensitive to Rover's intent touch. "...Luuk." 「陸，」漂泊者低語道，他柔軟的雙唇順著陸鋒利的下巴線條一路向下蹭過。陸的整個身體猛地顫抖了一下，對漂泊者帶有企圖心的觸碰敏感至極。「……陸。」 He peppers his skin with kisses, whispering his name, low and sweet, against each one that he leaves. And when his mouth finally finds the luminous cyan tracing the side of his neck, he grinds his hips down, shuddering with a tiny smile when he feels Luuk's answering arousal rub against his own. 他在陸的肌膚上落下一道又一道密集的親吻，每留下一個吻，就在他肌膚上低沉而甜美地呼喚一次他的名字。而當漂泊者的雙唇終於找到了陸頸側那道泛著螢光的青色紋路時，他向下磨擦著自己的臀部，在感覺到陸那隨之昂揚的興奮頂撞著自己時，帶著一絲微小而滿足的微笑微微顫抖起來。 So big already, and all he's done is kiss him chastely and say his name. 已經變得這麼大了，而漂泊者所做的，不過是純情地吻了吻他、呼喚了他的名字而已。 Warm hands settle over his waist, hoping to steady and still him.
